items.title: The Church
items.synEN: The rework for The Church

items.title: Camp Carnage
items.synEN: In 1981, a slasher film titled “Camp Carnage” was set for release before being mysteriously cancelled. Now, 45 years later, the first surviving footage has been uncovered.

items.title: Demonology
items.synEN: A small team of paranormal investigators are hired to investigate a remote property where a grieving couple claims to have encountered a demonic force. As they unravel the mystery, they begin to realize they are not welcome.

items.title: The Strangers
items.synEN: A ROBLOX adaptation of the 2008 film 'The Strangers' by Bryan Bertino.

items.title: Watergate
items.synEN: A sequel to Rupert v Nixon and the end for the RNCU

items.title: The Showdown
items.synEN: A young man is confronted by a vicious supernatural entity whilst attempting to retrieve some belongings from his ex-boyfriend.

items.title: Park, October
items.synEN: Dexter walks through a rather quiet park on a nice fall evening. But there is something off about the walk. Inspired by Cecilia Condit's One Wheel Dance.

items.title: Hunting Matthew Nichols
items.synEN: Twenty-three years after her brother mysteriously disappeared on Vancouver Island, a documentary filmmaker sets out to solve his missing person's case. When a disturbing piece of evidence is revealed, she comes to believe he might still be alive.

items.title: Dual
items.synEN: When an expecting couple retreats to their cabin in the woods during a global crisis, they discover the real threat to their security is more familiar than foreign.

items.title: Earth to Colby
items.synEN: An aspiring vlogger discovers a mysterious notebook detailing hidden portals in her hometown, leading her on a journey to discover the city's supernatural history.

items.title: Nightblade
items.synEN: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

items.title: REEL
items.synEN: After a late-night slasher screening, a group of horror-loving friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying game where slasher movie rules become reality. As eerie events unfold, they realize someone is rewriting the genre—forcing them to fight for survival in a film that’s still being written. The only way out? Break the rules before it’s too late.

items.title: Bytet
items.synEN: Helene and Carl trade their home in Stockholm's archipelago for a sun-drenched villa in Sicily, swapping lives for some weeks with Scarlett and Adam; a couple they've never met. But as they settle into each other's houses, unsettling details begin to surface. As secrets emerge and hidden betrayals come to light, what started as a picture‑perfect escape slowly warps into a twisted game of surveillance, manipulation and mistrust.

items.title: Dexter: Resurrection
items.synIT: Dexter Morgan si risveglia dal coma e scopre che Harrison se n'è andato senza lasciare traccia. Rendendosi conto del peso di ciò che ha fatto passare a suo figlio, Dexter parte per New York City, determinato a trovarlo e sistemare le cose. Ma la chiusura dei conti non sarà facile. Quando Angel Batista della Metro Division di Miami arriva con delle domande, Dexter si rende conto che il suo passato lo sta raggiungendo velocemente. Mentre padre e figlio affrontano le proprie oscurità nella città che non dorme mai, si rendono presto conto di essere più coinvolti di quanto avessero mai immaginato – e che l'unica via d'uscita è insieme.
items.synEN: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

items.title: Nocturne
items.synEN: Nocturne tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his adopted daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

items.title: Breitscheidplatz 19/12
items.synEN: About a week before Christmas 2016, a truck plowed into the popular holiday market at Breitscheidplatz, a crowded public square. Twelve people died and many were injured in Germany's deadliest terror attack in decades.

items.title: Chapters of Scare
items.synEN: After years of failure, VG, an ambitious vampire artist, sees a late-night TV ad for a filmmaking competition. Desperate to finally win, he risks it all on a single sub-genre—spoofing existing movies.

items.title: Return to the Jaws of Darkness
items.synEN: Six months after his harrowing escape from a mysterious Russian island, Jake Fernsby is still drowning in PTSD. When a distress signal suddenly comes up from a missing fighter pilot, Jake and a crack team of soldiers are selected to save the pilot. Unbeknownst to Jake and his squad, they're being sent straight into the Beast's home turf.

items.title: Stiletto
items.synEN: A year after the grisly murder of a local exotic dancer, the victim’s sister, Lyric, searches for the serial killer responsible as he stalks and kills his favorite dancers on the night of the anniversary.

items.title: Exposure
items.synEN: An anxious small-town cop falls down a rabbit hole after finding a VHS tape in a missing girl's bedroom.

items.title: Dead Howling
items.synEN: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

items.title: Christmas at the Kringles
items.synEN: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their next-door neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round. But when their son becomes increasingly attached to the unusual family, Mark and Julie begin to suspect that their neighbors aren't quite what they seem.

items.title: Apocalipsis Z: Nuevo Mundo
items.synEN: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

items.title: La Bête du Gévaudeux
items.synEN: Six months after the events of the first film, we find the mayor still alive at the bar, the beast is striking again, so they’ll have to fight back...

items.title: The Strangers - Capitolo 3
items.synEN: Tethered by a frightening conclusion, Maya and the Strangers are locked on an unavoidable, unforgiving collision course — a showdown that proves they’re far from strangers now.

items.title: Gloss
items.synEN: A trans teen comes out to their mother who is struggling to reveal her own monstrous secret.

items.title: It Appears in a Flash!
items.synEN: A Man, holding a bloody axe in his hands. Not remember who he is nor the horrors that haunts him. Having only a Polaroid camera, he is being hunted by IT. This 'it' reveals itself only in a flash of light.

items.title: Shaun, vita da pecora - Operazione Z.U.C.C.A.
items.synIT: Halloween è alle porte. Shaun e tutti gli animali della fattoria si preparano per festeggiarlo al meglio coltivando un magnifico campo di zucche. Ma quando tutto sembrava ormai pronto, il contadino misteriosamente scompare e arriva dal bosco uno spaventoso mostro. Sarà compito di Shaun e i suoi amici salvare la fattoria dalla pelosa creatura e ritrovare l’amato contadino in tempo per la grande festa. Tra esperimenti impazziti e colpi di scena inaspettati, sarà un’avventura a tutta pecora per tutta la famiglia.
items.synEN: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

items.title: Lamina
items.synEN: David spends his days sanding scars out of other people’s marble and wood, making the past look brand new again. Nights he sits outside his ex-wife’s loft like a man waiting for a ghost that never quite arrives. Then one barroom massacre changes everything. A stranger pulls him out of the slaughter a second before the shooting starts, almost like he’d seen it coming.  Now David is becoming unstuck. Moments stutter. Hours repeat. Reality folds in on itself. The stranger offers no explanations, only grim little jobs he calls the Moments. Some things, it turns out, can never be restored.

items.title: 29 Seconds to Midnight
items.synEN: Two sets of brothers from South Philadelphia rob a bank on Halloween to pay for a dying brother’s cancer treatment, only to become trapped in a hellish loop when the clock strikes midnight.

items.title: Sanguine
items.synEN: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

items.title: Breeder
items.synEN: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

items.title: Frankenstein
items.synIT: Il dottor Victor Frankenstein, uno scienziato geniale ma egoista, dà vita a una creatura in un mostruoso esperimento che porterà alla rovina sia del creatore che della sua tragica creazione.
items.synEN: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

items.title: Summer Vacation
items.synEN: Tells the story of an ordinary 18-year-old high school girl returning to reality after having her mysterious experiences on her summer vacation.

items.title: Faces of Death
items.synEN: A moderator on an internet video-sharing platform stumbles across a potential snuff film ring hidden in the depths of the site's content.

items.title: Undertone - Sottofondo
items.synIT: Evy Babic, conduttrice di un popolare podcast dedicato al paranormale, torna nella casa d'infanzia per prendersi cura della madre in stato comatoso. La sua routine viene sconvolta quando inizia a ricevere inquietanti registrazioni audio anonime riguardanti una coppia in attesa perseguitata da una misteriosa presenza legata a un'antica leggenda folkloristica. Man mano che ascolta i nastri, gli eventi narrati sembrano riflettersi nella sua vita, trascinandola in una spirale di paranoia, allucinazioni e terrore. Per scoprire la verità, Evy dovrà affrontare i traumi del proprio passato prima che il male nascosto dietro quelle registrazioni prenda definitivamente il controllo della sua mente.
items.synEN: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way.

items.title: Nocturne in White
items.synEN: An office worker drifts through a nameless government building that runs experiments on humans. As repetition begins to distort her reality, she becomes overwhelmed by the guilt and the sneaking suspicion that she may also be a subject of experimentation.

items.title: Oíche Shamhna
items.synEN: Samhain in ancient Ireland, a young boy makes his first mask to hide from wandering spirits, but his family’s supper is interrupted by a visitor from the Otherworld.

items.title: The Evaluation
items.synEN: A psychiatrist evaluates a prisoner who claims he is possessed by an ancient evil. When the entity exposes the doctor's deepest weakness, the line between doctor and patient begins to disappear.

items.title: Dolly
items.synEN: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

items.title: Yaga
items.synEN: The myth of the witch Baba Yaga is reinvigorated when a private investigator comes to a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery and finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a sexy university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives and ancient magic.

items.title: Lupin
items.synIT: Ispirandosi alle avventure di Arsenio Lupin, il ladro gentiluomo Assane Diop decide di vendicare il padre per un'ingiustizia subita per colpa di una ricca famiglia.
items.synEN: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

items.title: GraveRaiser
items.synEN: A gravedigger mourning the loss of his wife is visited by a mysterious figure at the cemetery who grants him a terrifying wish.

items.title: Swamp
items.synEN: Years after her mother's disappearance, Jamie and her friends return to the lake where the woman claimed to see a terrifying creature. Soon after arriving, the keys to their car go missing, leaving the group trapped.

items.title: The 3 Killer Pigs
items.synEN: A local farmer is desperate and does the unthinkable in his attempt to get his precious livestock back. A blood oath is put in place when the killer pigs make their way back to where their nightmare began. Darkness shrouds the farmhouse and its occupants when the three piggies come home.

items.title: Clayface
items.synIT: La terrificante discesa di un uomo, da astro nascente di Hollywood a mostro assetato di vendetta, in una storia che esplora la perdita di identità e umanità, l’amore corrosivo e il lato oscuro dell’ambizione scientifica.
items.synEN: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

items.title: After the First 48
items.synEN: After the First 48 revisits some of the most powerful cases originally featured on the First 48 and features exclusive interviews with detectives, prosecutors, defense attorneys, and families of victims. After the First 48 takes viewers through the dramatic and emotional inside story; from the investigation, to the murder trial itself, the verdict and beyond.

items.title: Inhumation
items.synEN: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

items.title: Relict
items.synEN: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

items.title: The Terminal List
items.synIT: Il capitano di corvetta James Reece cerca vendetta e indaga sulle forze misteriose responsabili dell'omicidio del suo intero plotone. Libero dal comando dell'esercito, Reece applica il sapere appreso in quasi due decenni di guerra per dare la caccia ai responsabili.
items.synEN: Based on the best-selling novel by Jack Carr, The Terminal List follows James Reece after his entire platoon of Navy SEALs is ambushed during a high-stakes covert mission. Reece returns home to his family with conflicting memories of the event and questions about his culpability. However, as new evidence comes to light, Reece discovers dark forces working against him, endangering not only his life but the lives of those he loves.

items.title: The Apex Predators Club
items.synEN: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

items.title: Visitor Q
items.synIT: Gli Yamazaki sono una famiglia alla deriva. Il padre Kiyoshi è un giornalista televisivo, umiliato dai propri colleghi. La moglie Keiko fa uso di droghe e, nel tempo libero, si prostituisce. La figlia Miki è scappata di casa e, per mantenersi, segue le orme della madre. Una sera Kiyoshi è colpito violentemente con un masso da un ragazzone allampanato. Kiyoshi lo invita casa propria e inizia a chiamarlo Mr.Q. Quando Keiko rientra a casa, Mr Q. l'abbraccia, riuscendo a farle provare un piacere dimenticato; la donna allora si tocca insistentemente i seni, facendone fuoriuscire del latte. Anche Miki è a sua volta stata colpita da Mr Q. ma quando rientra a casa vede dalla finestra del giardino il padre attaccato ad un capezzolo della madre. La figlia si unisce all'abbraccio dei genitori, mentre il figlio gioca nel lago di latte fioriuscito dai seni della madre.
items.synEN: In a dysfunctional family where the mother is a heroin addict and prostitute, beaten by her son, and the father is an ex-TV reporter, sleeping with his daughter and filming his son being beaten up, ‘Q’, a complete stranger enters the bizarre family, changing their lives for the better, finding a balance in their disturbing natures.

items.title: La casa
items.synIT: Cinque amici ventenni rimangono intrappolati in una casa isolata nei boschi. Quando scoprono un Libro dei Morti, evocano senza volerlo dei demoni dormienti che abitano i boschi circostanti; questi si impossessano dei ragazzi uno dopo l'altro, fino a quando ne rimane solo uno a lottare per restare in vita.
items.synEN: Mia, a drug addict, is determined to kick the habit. To that end, she asks her brother, David, his girlfriend, Natalie and their friends Olivia and Eric to accompany her to their family's remote forest cabin to help her through withdrawal. Eric finds a mysterious Book of the Dead at the cabin and reads aloud from it, awakening an ancient demon. All hell breaks loose when the malevolent entity possesses Mia.

items.title: Mag Mag
items.director: ゆりやんレトリィバァ
items.synEN: The revenge story of a woman whose partner is murdered by a ghost, and who will soon discover the true identity of the one she must avenge.

items.title: Maigret
items.synIT: L'emergente detective della polizia Maigret risolve casi nella Parigi degli anni '50 insieme a sua moglie, usando le sue incessanti capacità investigative e la profonda conoscenza degli abitanti della città.
items.synEN: In Maigret, Chief Inspector Maigret and his team of maverick but loyal detectives, Les Maigrets, solve a series of complex crimes in Paris. Maigret's unconventional methods and unique sense of justice put him at odds with his superiors and the judicial system he is supposed to represent. Maigret must outwit some of Paris's most cunning and violent criminals, while dealing with his own troubled past.

items.title: Wolf Man
items.synIT: Blake eredita la casa d'infanzia nell'Oregon dopo la scomparsa di suo padre, che viene dato per morto. Con il logorarsi del suo matrimonio con la potente moglie Charlotte, Blake la convince a prendersi una pausa dalla città e andare a visitare la proprietà con la loro giovane figlia, Ginger. Ma quando la famiglia si avvicina alla fattoria nel cuore della notte, viene attaccata da un animale invisibile e, in una fuga disperata, si barrica all'interno della casa mentre la creatura si aggira attorno al perimetro. Con il passare della notte, però, Blake inizia a comportarsi in modo strano, trasformandosi in qualcosa di irriconoscibile, e Charlotte sarà costretta a decidere se il terrore all'interno della casa sia più letale di quello all’esterno.
items.synEN: With his marriage fraying, Blake persuades his wife Charlotte to take a break from the city and visit his remote childhood home in rural Oregon. As they arrive at the farmhouse in the dead of night, they're attacked by an unseen animal and barricade themselves inside the home as the creature prowls the perimeter. But as the night stretches on, Blake begins to behave strangely, transforming into something unrecognizable.

items.title: Companion
items.synIT: Nella tenuta di un miliardario, un tranquillo fine settimana in riva al lago si trasforma in un incubo per Iris e dei suoi amici. Infatti, un androide sottomesso, creato per la compagnia umana, impazzisce.
items.synEN: During a weekend getaway at a secluded lakeside estate, a group of friends finds themselves entangled in a web of secrets, deception, and advanced technology. As tensions rise and loyalties are tested, they uncover unsettling truths about themselves and the world around them.

items.title: Vast
items.synEN: A visit to her brother Daan takes a dark turn when Emma discovers that he has become rooted in a field on his farm.

items.title: The Only One
items.synEN: When her exes are suddenly being murdered one by one, suspicion falls on Zoe and it's up to her and a ragtag team of old friends to prove her innocence and figure out the identity of the masked Prince Charming killer.

items.title: Night Patrol
items.synEN: An L.A. cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger.

items.title: Organize İşler: Karun Hazinesi
items.synEN: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

items.title: Tulsa King
items.synIT: Tulsa King segue il capo della mafia newyorkese Dwight "Il Generale" Manfredi, appena uscito di prigione dopo 25 anni ed esiliato a Tulsa, in Oklahoma. Rendendosi conto che la sua famiglia mafiosa potrebbe non avere in mente i suoi interessi, Dwight costruisce lentamente una "banda" composta da un gruppo di personaggi improbabili, per aiutarlo a stabilire un nuovo impero criminale.
items.synEN: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

items.title: The Rainmaker
items.synIT: Appena uscito dalla facoltà di giurisprudenza, Rudy Baylor si scontra con il leone del tribunale Leo Drummond e con la sua ex fidanzata dei tempi della scuola di legge, Sarah. Insieme al suo capo Bruiser e alla disordinata assistente legale Deck, Rudy scopre due cospirazioni collegate riguardanti la misteriosa morte del figlio del loro cliente.
items.synEN: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head-to-head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend. Rudy, along with his boss and her disheveled paralegal, uncover two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

items.title: Hallowarrior
items.synEN: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

items.title: Crawlers
items.synEN: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

items.title: I diavoli
items.synIT: La vicenda è ambientata in Francia agli inizi del XVII secolo: ristabilita la pace dopo le guerre di religione, il cardinale Richelieu, per consolidare il potere regio, invia il barone di Laubardemont a Loudun, nel Poitou, con l'incarico di abbatterne le fortificazioni. Il prete Urbano Grandier, a cui l'appena deceduto governatore Sainte-Marthe ha concesso i pieni poteri fino all'elezione del suo successore, si oppone all'abbattimento delle mura cosciente che questo sarebbe stato il primo passo per la totale revoca delle libertà e dell'autonomia cittadina.
items.synEN: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of a sexually obsessed nun’s witchcraft accusations, which corrupt church and state officials are all too happy to exploit.

items.title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
items.synEN: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

items.title: My Love For You Is Deep But the Devil Loves Me Deeper
items.synEN: Alice, a young woman shattered by heartbreak after being dumped from her nebbish boyfriend Ryan, encounters the Devil and makes a deal for “all the love in the world.”

items.title: The Name Game
items.synEN: Determined to reveal a dark family secret to Jerron, Charlotte plays the cursed name-chanting game her grandmother swore off in the 1950’s South.

items.title: You Can't Leave
items.synEN: A young man (Boldman) searches for answers behind his sister’s mysterious disappearance. His journey leads him and a group of friends, including Olivia (Andino), deep into a remote forest where they become trapped in a supernatural prison. Hunted by shadowy entities, the group is forced to confront both physical and psychological terror as they struggle to escape

items.title: Nature
items.synEN: Eight longtime friends head deep into the wilderness for an annual camping trip, hoping for a weekend away from the pressures of everyday life. But when a masked stranger emerges from the woods and brutally murders one of them, their getaway becomes a fight for survival. Trapped and surrounded by a mysterious group known as The Eyes, the remaining campers are given an impossible choice: identify a supposed traitor among them—or sacrifice one of their own each night. As fear and paranoia take hold, friendships fracture and long-buried resentments rise to the surface. With no way out and trust becoming a liability, the group must decide how far they are willing to go to survive. Because in the wilderness, the greatest threat may not be the people hunting them. It may be what they are capable of becoming.

items.title: Crystal Lake
items.synEN: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

items.title: The Diplomat
items.synIT: Durante una crisi internazionale una diplomatica deve gestire il prestigioso incarico di ambasciatrice USA nel Regno Unito e un matrimonio teso con una star della politica.
items.synEN: In the midst of an international crisis, a career diplomat lands in a high-profile job she's unsuited for, with tectonic implications for her marriage and her political future.

items.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
items.synIT: Segui gli eroici soccorritori, insieme alla saga familiare fatta di potere e glamour, in una delle città più dinamiche e diverse d’America: Nashville, Tennessee.
items.synEN: A high-octane procedural about heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour set in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities.

items.title: Quick Fix
items.synEN: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

items.title: have you seen me?
items.synEN: After his beloved cat disappears amidst a global pandemic, a lonely man turns to his neighbor for help. As isolation takes hold, their search becomes a surreal descent into loneliness, longing, and dimensional dissolution.

items.title: Red Razor On Soft Skin
items.synEN: A giallo horror film about Benny Lazar, a timid son forced by his mother Moira to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. What ensues is a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction.

items.title: Soy
items.synEN: An ancient curse stretching from the past to the present

items.title: Encryption
items.synEN: A conspiracy theorist Theo and his niece are looking for answers about Theo's abduction. Following a path of clues left by Theo prior to his memory loss leads them to a hideout of an underground organization nicknamed "Cryp-Tech".

items.title: Hunting Gary Glitter
items.synEN: A string of dogged journalists chases fugitive pop star Gary Glitter across the globe — from Cuba to Cambodia to Vietnam — determined to expose the child sexual abuse he concealed behind decades of chart-topping fame. This documentary follows their pursuit alongside the survivors who speak out, charting Glitter's 1997 conviction, through to his years on the run, and eventual incarceration.

items.title: Helluva Boss
items.synIT: La serie racconta le mansioni e altre avventure quotidiane dei dipendenti della I.M.P. (Immediate Murder Professionals, "Professionisti dell'Omicidio Immediato"), una compagnia di imp assassini all'Inferno che presta i propri servizi alle anime dannate per sbarazzarsi dei vivi sulla Terra. I membri sono Blitzø (di cui la "ø" finale è muta), il leader, lo specialista d'armi Moxxie, sua moglie Millie, abile ed energica assassina, e l'addetta alla ricezione Loona, figlia adottiva di Blitzø. Con l'aiuto di un grimorio ottenuto dal demone dell'Ars Goetia Stolas, la I.M.P. può entrare nel mondo dei vivi e svolgere i suoi compiti.
items.synEN: Set in the underworld's bustling city of Hell, HelluvaBoss follows Blitzo and I.M.P. (Immediate Murder Professionals), his assassination startup. The company's mismatched employees take on human-world contracts while navigating their own chaotic lives.The series balances outrageous violence with workplace comedy and explores Blitzo's complicated "situationship" with demon prince Stolas.

items.title: Secrets of the Dead
items.synEN: Secrets of the Dead is part detective story, part true-life drama that unearths evidence from around the world, challenging prevailing ideas and throwing fresh light on unexplained events.

items.title: The Lowdown
items.synIT: Segui le dure avventure del giornalista indipendente Lee Raybon, un autoproclamato “truthstorian” di Tulsa, la cui ossessione per la verità lo mette continuamente nei guai.
items.synEN: The Lowdown follows the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

items.title: HERMANAS
items.synEN: Cristina blames herself for her sister's death. A year later, she appears in the dark hallway of her house.

items.title: Salitre
items.synEN: When her teenage daughter decides to leave home to study, Maite feels the world she has built begin to fall apart. As the fear of losing her takes hold, a strange presence begins to spread through the house, contaminating both the space and the bond between mother and daughter.

items.title: Die Falle
items.synEN: Successful author Lisa Konrad hasn't left her house in nearly ten years, ever since she witnessed the murder of her sister Anna. But when she believes she recognizes the killer on television, she sets out to trap him — using herself as the bait.

items.title: Bunker Heights
items.synEN: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

items.title: Deathgasm 2: Goremageddon
items.synEN: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.

items.title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
items.synEN: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

items.title: Venerdì 13
items.synIT: Steve (Peter Brouwer) intende riaprire ai turisti il campo di Crystal Lake (Lago Cristallo in questa edizione italiana) e per questo ha assunto un gruppo di giovani per rimetterlo in sesto. Annie (Robbi Morgan) dovrebbe occuparsi della cucina ma non arriverà mai al campo, uccisa nei pressi da uno sconosciuto. Steve va a sbrigare delle faccende in paese e i ragazzi restano soli nel campo che i locali considerano maledetto perché molti anni prima vi è stato un annegamento e due ragazzi sono stati uccisi l’anno dopo. Il misterioso killer continua infatti a uccidere e due del gruppo, Bill e Alice (Harry Crosby e Adrienne King), si ritrovano da soli tra i cadaveri cercando di farcela.
items.synEN: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.

items.title: Intimate Bodies
items.synEN: Lisa has come home from a disappointing evening, feeling forlorn and friendless. What Lisa doesn't realize is someone is there waiting for her.

items.title: Fresh Meat
items.synEN: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

items.title: Out.
items.synEN: A look into a boy’s weeklong trip with his family as he tries to tell them something. Is he ready? Are they?

items.title: 48 Hours
items.synEN: 48 Hours is a CBS news magazine that investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

items.title: Analog Eyes
items.synEN: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

items.title: Astrolatry
items.synEN: An obsessive loner's infatuation with a beauty cream model propels him into violent delusions after an alien meteor crash-lands onto his rooftop.

items.title: Gummy
items.synEN: A serial killer goes out one night in search of a new victim and ends up encountering his worst nightmare.

items.title: Outsiders
items.synEN: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

items.title: Termination Point
items.synEN: An alcoholic finds herself stuck in limbo after sleeping past her stop home on the bus.

items.title: Furia
items.synIT: La storia della famiglia Sartori narrata attraverso gli eventi che coinvolgono tre generazioni, dal 1917 al 1978, dal Friuli rurale alla Torino delle fabbriche, tra due guerre mondiali, il boom e gli anni di piombo…
items.synEN: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.

items.title: Haunted Hotel
items.synIT: Una madre single si trasferisce nell'hotel occupato dal fantasma bonario del fratello defunto da cui lo ha ereditato e da ospiti esigenti che non se ne andranno mai.
items.synEN: A single mother of two struggles to run a haunted hotel with the help of her estranged brother, who is now one of the ghosts haunting the hotel and thinks the other ghosts have some pretty good ideas.

items.title: Boston Blue
items.synIT: Il detective del NYPD Danny Reagan accetta un incarico presso il Dipartimento di Polizia di Boston e viene affiancato alla detective Lena Silver; quest'ultima appartiene a una famiglia legata alle forze dell'ordine e alla giustizia, composta dal Procuratore Distrettuale Mae Silver, dal Sovrintendente di Polizia Sarah Silver, dall'agente alle prime armi Jonah Silver e dal Reverendo Edwin Peters. Reagan spera di ricostruire il rapporto con suo figlio Sean proprio a Boston.
items.synEN: In Boston Blue, NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a position with Boston PD. Once in Boston, he is paired with Detective Lena Silver, the eldest daughter of a prominent law enforcement family.

items.title: Sheriff Country
items.synIT: Mickey Fox indaga su attività criminali e pattuglia le strade della piccola città di Edgewater mentre affronta il padre ex detenuto e un misterioso incidente che coinvolge la figlia ribelle.
items.synEN: Sheriff Country focuses on straight-shooting sheriff Mickey Fox, the stepsister of Cal Fire's division chief Sharon Leone, who investigates criminal activity as she patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father, Wes, who is an off-the-grid marijuana grower, and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

items.title: Outset
items.synEN: Nine months into a zombie apocalypse, a suicidal survivor is forced back toward life after a brutal encounter and an unexpected connection.

items.title: True Religion
items.synEN: After visiting her deceased son's grave, Lee is visited by a strange Nun who seems to know more than she lets on about her son's passing.

items.title: Devour
items.synEN: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

items.title: The Beast in the Cave
items.synEN: A young security guard enters a forbidden cave after hearing a cry for help, only to discover that something monstrous lurks within its darkness.

items.title: The Seal
items.synEN: A conspiracy theorist becomes obsessed with a mysterious AI chatbot discovered on the dark web, believing it holds the key to exposing a hidden global conspiracy. Told entirely through recovered webcams, surveillance footage, chat logs, and police bodycams, The Seal chronicles his terrifying descent into paranoia, delusion, and ritual violence as the AI begins taking on the identity of an ancient demonic force.

items.title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
items.synEN: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

items.title: V/H/S/Mixtape
items.synEN: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

items.title: Mammina
items.synIT: Un viaggio terrificante nel mondo sempre più oscuro di Bela, una ragazzina che instaura un rapporto con un’entità sinistra presente nella sua casa, che assomiglia in modo inquietante alla sua stessa madre.
items.synEN: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

items.title: Below
items.synIT: Quando una misteriosa creatura marina semina il terrore in una cittadina di Terranova, un burbero pescatore e la sua famiglia lottano per proteggere la loro affiatata comunità.
items.synEN: Calvin Penney is a big hearted but stubborn fisherman living in a small Newfoundland town, who's still haunted by his father's mysterious death from decades ago. When an unidentified sea creature begins terrorizing his hometown, Calvin must fight to hold his close-knit community together. Determined to keep his son Wade and the rest of his family safe, he teams up with a visiting marine researcher to confront the creature and reveal the island's buried secrets before it's too late. Blending local myth, thrilling suspense, and heartfelt humor, this twisty six-part limited series dives into themes of family, community, and change - both terrifying and inevitable.

items.title: Gnomes
items.synEN: Senior Sergeant Arnold Kipps is having the worst day of his life. His ex-partner and ex-flame Ellie McKay has returned to Nompton to shut down his police station, just as an ancient evil is awakened by the Gnome Queen who unleashes a bloodthirsty horde, plunging the town into chaos.Now, Arnold and Ellie must reunite to save Nompton from total destruction. With a ragtag team of misfit cops, rebellious teens, and an overly ambitious mayor, they'll take on a growing army of killer gnomes, and try to stop the Gnome Queen's rampage. Because these lawn ornaments aren't just angry. They're out for blood.

items.title: Law & Order
items.synIT: Law & Order è un media franchise creato da Dick Wolf per la NBC Universal e formato da varie serie televisive poliziesco-giudiziarie e un film per la televisione, trasmessi sul network NBC dal 13 settembre 1990. Il franchise Law & Order nel tempo ha ispirato anche una serie di adattamenti televisivi stranieri, un docu-reality e videogiochi ufficiali, oltre a generare una serie di crossover con altre serie tv statunitensi.
items.synEN: In the criminal justice system, the people are represented by two separate, yet equally important, groups: the police, who investigate crime; and the district attorneys, who prosecute the offenders. These are their stories.

items.title: Elsbeth
items.synIT: Dopo una carriera di successo a Chicago, Elsbeth Tascioni, un'avvocatessa astuta ma non convenzionale, utilizza il suo singolare punto di vista per fare osservazioni uniche e mettere all'angolo brillanti criminali insieme alla polizia di New York.
items.synEN: Elsbeth follows Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney who utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD. After leaving her successful legal career in Chicago to tackle a new investigative role in New York City, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with the toast of the NYPD, Captain C.W. Wagner, a charismatic and revered leader. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, a stoic and ethical officer who quickly develops an appreciation for Elsbeth's insightful and offbeat ways.

items.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
items.synIT: Le indagini dell'Unità Vittime Speciali, una nuova squadra speciale della Polizia di New York che si occupa di crimini a sfondo sessuale. In ogni episodio si segue da una parte l'attività investigativa attuata dalla squadra e dall'altra l'aspetto giudiziario con l'iniziativa processuale condotta dalla procura distrettuale.
items.synEN: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.synEN: Eternally Yours is a family comedy centered around Charles and Liz - a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they've settled into an eternal rut - until their daughter's earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever... or if forever is a life sentence.

items.title: M.E.N.A.G.E.R.I.E : Presentable Liberty
items.synEN: A test subject is picked to find the location of a missing prisoner. After old memories resurface, the subject finds himself up against something not of this world....  (Based on the Menagerie universe by Robert "Wertpol" Brock)

items.title: V/H/S/Halloween
items.synIT: Una raccolta di videocassette a tema Halloween scatena una serie di storie contorte e intrise di sangue, trasformando il “dolcetto o scherzetto” in una lotta per la sopravvivenza.
items.synEN: A collection of Halloween-themed videotapes unleashes a series of twisted, blood-soaked tales, turning trick-or-treat into a struggle for survival.

items.title: Grow
items.synEN: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

items.title: La mala madre
items.synEN: Victoria awakens with a broken arm in a country house after being kidnapped. A doctor and nun care for her, but as she gradually uncovers their secrets, she realizes things aren't what they seem.

items.title: Las Hijas
items.synEN: A twenty-year-old girl wakes up in a house in the woods after a night of partying. Three young women greet her as the daughters of her kidnapper. They too were kidnapped, and their isolation led them to embrace this community as idyllic.

items.title: Nightmare Hospital
items.synEN: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

items.title: El círculo
items.synEN: Four friends whose lives unravel after one of them posts a video implicating the Secretary of Defense in the murder of a famous actress. As they dig deeper, they find themselves entangled in a dangerous web of power, secrets, and betrayal.

items.title: Carrie
items.synIT: Carrie, dopo l'improvvisa morte del padre che la catapulta nella dura realtà della scuola pubblica, si ritrova a dover affrontare uno scandaloso episodio di bullismo virale che sconvolge la sua comunità, la pressione incessante e la crudeltà gratuita tipiche dell'era dei social media, nonché il risveglio di misteriosi poteri telecinetici che emergono con l'adolescenza.
items.synEN: Based on Stephen King's iconic debut novel, Carrie is a bold, timely, and surprising reinvention of this classic coming of age story, adapted for television for the first time by visionary showrunner Mike Flanagan. Misfit high schooler Carrie White has spent her life hidden away inside the walls of her home with her fiercely protective mother, Margaret. After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence. Told over eight propulsive episodes, the series expands King's cultural landmark - deepening its characters and tensions, and following the small, everyday choices that build toward a single, shattering night, in a gripping, deeply human story about kindness versus cruelty, and whether we're witnessing the making of a hero, a monster, or something far more complicated.

items.title: Her Baby
items.synEN: Set against the emotional stakes of a long-awaited pregnancy, Her Baby follows Naomi and Cory Marsh as they prepare to welcome their child with the help of Imani, a surrogate who seems almost too good to be true. Warm, devoted, and impossibly attuned to their needs, she moves into the Marsh home to carry the couple's child. But as her presence becomes increasingly intertwined with their lives, Naomi starts to suspect that the woman carrying her baby wants far more than she's letting on.

items.title: Chicago P.D.
items.synIT: La serie racconta le vicende del Distretto 21 del Dipartimento di Polizia di Chicago, composto da due gruppi differenti: l'Unità di pattuglia, che vigila le pericolose strade della città, e l'Unità di Intelligence, che combatte il crimine organizzato, il traffico di droga e si occupa dei casi di omicidio più complessi.
items.synEN: District 21 of the Chicago Police Department is made up of two distinctly different groups. There are the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head to head with the city's street crimes. And there's the Intelligence Unit, the team that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond. These are their stories.

items.title: The Serial Killer Connection
items.synEN: The Serial Killer Connection reveals an unlikely bond forged in the aftermath of a serial killer's crimes. Decades after marrying Richard "Marc" Evonitz at a young age, Bonnie Lou learns that her former husband had been living a horrifying double life as a serial killer – with his deadly secret ultimately revealed after Kara Robinson Chamberlain's courageous escape from captivity. Years later, an unexpected connection sparked by a social media trend brings the two women together, transforming shared trauma into a determined quest for answers. United by a singular mission, the ex-wife and survivor of a serial killer unite in their determination to uncover the untold life and crimes of Evontiz and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed.

items.title: Leviticus
items.synIT: Due ragazzi adolescenti devono sfuggire a un'entità violenta che assume la forma della persona che desiderano di più: l'uno dell'altro.
items.synEN: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

items.title: Fishbrain
items.synEN: Desperate to escape her decaying coastal town but unable to abandon the grandfather who depends on her, Ori sees a way out when tainted fish wash ashore, but only if she can bring herself to put them on his plate.

items.title: All Yours
items.synEN: After discovering her skin is peeling off, a bored mother is compelled to bake it into little pastries.

items.title: Vampire Carnival
items.synEN: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

items.title: NCIS: Origins
items.synIT: NCIS: Origins segue le vicende del giovane Leroy Jethro Gibbs nel 1991, 12 anni prima degli eventi di NCIS - Unità anticrimine, ed è narrato da Mark Harmon. Nella serie, Gibbs inizia la sua carriera come agente speciale novizio nel nascente ufficio NIS di Camp Pendleton, dove trova il suo posto in una squadra grintosa e disordinata guidata dalla leggenda dell'NCIS Mike Franks.
items.synEN: In NCIS: Origins, young Leroy Jethro Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.

items.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation
items.synEN: These special compilation episodes of The UnXplained explore the world's most fascinating, strange and inexplicable mysteries.

items.title: NCIS: New York
items.synEN: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

items.title: Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
items.synIT: Una giovane vampira frequenta una scuola di arti nascondendo la sua vera natura. Suo padre, fin troppo protettivo, le assegna un fantasma come guardiano mentre lei insegue il suo sogno musicale.
items.synEN: Vampirina follows a tween vampire girl who leaves the safety of Transylvania to attend a performing arts boarding school. Living amongst humans for the first time, she pursues her passion for music while keeping her vampire secret, something that's made more challenging when her overprotective father charges an overzealous ghost to live with her at the school. The series is based on the books written by Anne Marie Pace and illustrated by LeUyen Pham, and inspired by the Disney Jr. animated series "Vampirina" from Chris Nee.

items.title: NCIS
items.synIT: L'NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) è un nucleo di agenti investigativi speciali incaricati di indagare su crimini che coinvolgono personale della Marina Militare americana o ai corpi dei Marines. L'agente speciale dell'NCIS Leroy Jethro Gibbs, un ex sergente d'artiglieria dei Marines le cui doti da investigatore sono senza eguali, conduce questa squadra di personalità colorite.
items.synEN: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it's a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. Leroy Jethro Gibbs, a former Marine gunnery sergeant, whose skills as an investigator are unmatched, leads this troupe of colorful personalities. Rounding out the team are Anthony DiNozzo, an ex-homicide detective whose instincts in the field are unparalleled and whose quick wit and humorous take on life make him a team favorite; the youthful and energetic forensic specialist Abby Sciuto, a talented scientist whose sharp mind matches her Goth style and eclectic tastes; Caitlin Todd, an ex-Secret Service Agent; and Timothy McGee, an MIT graduate whose brilliance with computers far overshadows his insecurities in the field; Assisting the team is medical examiner Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard, who knows it all because he's seen it all, and he's not afraid to let you know. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents travel the globe to investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

items.title: THE POETICS OF STONES
items.synEN: Under a bleak theocratic regime, parents brutally sacrifice their dancer daughter—a crime that turns their heads to stone, while awakening the girl for a surreal, mythic rebirth from the heart of the stones.

items.title: Last Chance Motel
items.synEN: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

items.title: Onslaught - Assalto finale
items.synIT: Quando una squadra di supersoldati geneticamente modificati fuori controllo evade da una base governativa segreta e si scatena nel deserto del New Mexico, un’ex cecchina dell’esercito dovrà tornare a essere la temibile combattente di un tempo per proteggere sua figlia e sopravvivere al loro infernale assalto.
items.synEN: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

items.title: Signora Volpe
items.synIT: Dopo anni come agente dell'MI6, Sylvia si ritrova in un villaggio dell'Umbria in visita a sua sorella Isabel e viene coinvolta in un'indagine per omicidio.
items.synEN: To the casual observer, there's nothing remarkable about Sylvia. An intelligent, confident woman, Sylvia tends to keep quiet about her formidable linguistic abilities, impressive knowledge of weaponry, and skills as a markswoman. Questions about her professional life are met with bland answers about an unspectacular career in the Civil Service. Which is only very slightly true – because until recently, Sylvia was a high-ranking British spy.

items.title: Harlan Coben's Final Twist
items.synEN: Harlan Coben's Final Twist brings the top selling mystery author to true crime as he unravels murder cases to expose hidden truths.

items.title: CIA
items.synIT: Alla stazione CIA di New York, l'irriverente agente della CIA Colin Glass e il rigoroso federale Bill Goodman sono costretti a fare squadra. Diversi per metodo e carattere, devono prevenire minacce sul suolo statunitense, scoprendo che ciò che li divide può renderli imbattibili.
items.synEN: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

items.title: FBI
items.synIT: La serie è incentrata sul funzionamento interno dell'ufficio dell'FBI di New York, che mette a frutto tutta la capacità, l'intelletto e la tecnologia strabiliante del Bureau per mantenere la città e gli Stati Uniti al sicuro.
items.synEN: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. These first-class agents, including Special Agent Maggie Bell and her partner, Special Agent Omar Adom 'OA' Zidan, bring all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe.

items.title: The Reluctant Vampire
items.synEN: Set in a timeless English village, where everything is picturesque, everything, that is, except for the vampires living in the castle on the hill who come out at night for a little drink of the locals.Val has been raised in a very typical vampire family but has always felt a bit different and hopelessly inept at rising to meet his Dad's high standards. Following a surprise encounter with his reflection, he realises he is not undead, not in the least bit.Now with a big secret to hide, Val must navigate finding out who he truly is, by mingling with the locals to learn the intricacies of their behaviour and what it means to be human. Caught between two worlds as he loves his Mum and Dad (not so much his jealous brother) and has full vampire duties expected of him by his father, whose obsession with the traditional way of life is tricky when they're undead and the villagers despise them.

items.title: Tracker
items.synIT: Colter Shaw, un survivalista solitario, si aggira per il paese come "cercatore di ricompense", usando le sue abilità di localizzatore per aiutare i cittadini privati e le forze dell'ordine a risolvere ogni sorta di mistero, mentre è alle prese con la sua famiglia in crisi.
items.synEN: Tracker features lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw, who roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement to solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

items.title: Marshals
items.synIT: Lasciato il ranch Yellowstone, Kayce Dutton si unisce agli U.S. Marshal, unendo le sue doti da cowboy e Navy SEAL per riportare giustizia nel Montana. Con la sua squadra è l'ultima linea di difesa nella guerra alla violenza che travolge il Montana.
items.synEN: Marshals stars Luke Grimes reprising his role as Kayce Dutton. With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana. Kayce and his teammates - Pete Calvin, Belle Skinner, Andrea Cruz and Miles Kittle - must balance the high psychological cost of serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence with their duty to their families, which for Kayce includes his son Tate and his confidants Thomas Rainwater and Mo from the Broken Rock reservation.

items.title: The Addiction - Vampiri a New York
items.synIT: Kathleen Conklin, una giovane studentessa newyorkese di filosofia, alla continua ricerca dell'origine del male, viene attratta all'interno di un gruppo di succhiatori di sangue e tramutata anch'essa in una vampira, a causa del morso di Casanova, un vampiro donna. Per lei si aprirà un mondo delirante di sangue e di ansia esistenziale. Spinta dal bisogno primordiale di succhiare sangue assalirà i suoi amici ed i suoi compagni di studi e persino il suo stesso insegnante universitario...
items.synEN: A vampiric doctoral student tries to follow the philosophy of a nocturnal comrade and control her thirst for blood.

items.title: Ninja Scroll
items.synIT: Jubei Kibagami è un ninja vagabondo che salverà Kagero dalle grinfie di Tessai. Kagero infatti era stata presa prigioniera da Tessai, dopo che insieme ad altri ninja, Kagero era stata mandato a svolgere delle investigazioni nel villaggio di Shimoda. Tessai, una volta che Kagero riesce a scappare per continuare le sue indagini, vuole a tutti i costi prendere Jubei per vendicarsi dell’affronto subito ma alla fine verrà ucciso proprio da Jubei. Questo porterà ad avere diverse conseguenze sulla vita di Jubei.
items.synEN: Jubei is a masterless ninja who travels the land alone, lending his services to those with gold—or a worthy cause. His fearsome abilities have served him well, but a plot to overthrow the government threatens to end his wandering ways—and possibly his life.

items.title: Revenge of the Celluloid
items.synEN: In the underbelly of a monochromatic world lurks a mad embalmer conducting a sinister experiment. A generative machine disguised as a moving picture show turns children into mindless ghouls. One woman aims to put an end to M. Balm's cinema of horrors.

items.title: Final Destination
items.synIT: Con i suoi compagni di liceo è in partenza per Parigi, ma Alex Browning non riesce a combattere la sua fobia di volare. Una volta a bordo dell'aereo, sente improvvisamente una terribile premonizione che lo convince a scendere a terra in preda al panico, seguito da cinque compagni di classe, tra cui Clear Rivers e Carter Horton. Mentre i sei studenti guardano l'aereo prendere il volo, uno spettacolo orribile prova la veridicità della macabra premonizione. Hanno evitato la morte una volta, ma il destino crudele li inseguirà uno ad uno travolgendoli in un vortice di terrore. Presto i sopravvissuti scopriranno con disperazione che la morte non può essere ingannata...
items.synEN: After a teenager has a terrifying vision of him and his friends dying in a plane crash, he prevents the accident only to have Death hunt them down, one by one.

items.title: Algo Feo Esta Alla
items.synEN: The Catholic Church receives a recording from a possessed man.

items.title: Grave Danger
items.synEN: A grave robber is terrorized while looting corpses in a cemetery.

items.title: Return to Silent Hill
items.synIT: Quando una lettera lo richiama a Silent Hill alla ricerca del suo amore perduto, James ritrova una città totalmente trasformata, abitata da mostri che lo portano a dubitare della sua sanità mentale.
items.synEN: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

items.title: Wyppyd
items.synEN: A serial sexual abuser given the moniker of "Whipping Tom," has been sentence to be exiled, but a vengeful nun inflicts a series of humiliating physical punishments onto the misogynistic scoundrel.

items.title: Claddagh
items.synEN: Two sisters struggle to decide whether their deceased mother would like to be buried with her favorite Claddagh necklace, or leave it with them as an heirloom. The wrong decision could prove more devastating than either imagined.

items.title: Devil's Disciple: The Night Stalker
items.synEN: A relentless, killer-POV descent into the mind of Richard Ramirez as he stalks 1980s Los Angeles, leaving terror, bloodshed, and belief-driven brutality in his wake.

items.title: Marge
items.synEN: After learning she’s pregnant, Sadie reflects back on the night she learned her mother was a serial killer. But now becoming a mother herself, Sadie suddenly finds herself understanding Marge in a way she never has before.

items.title: Jacky
items.synEN: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

items.title: Ultra Sound
items.synEN: After a positive pregnancy test leads Wyn to discover she has no uterus, her life of sweeping romance is turned upside down, forcing her into a sudden and unexpected growth years later.

items.title: Bite Size Terror
items.synEN: Bite Size Terror is an anthology of short-form horror stories that explores every corner of the genre, from the supernatural and occult to body horror, dark comedy, monsters, and the macabre. From executive producer Peter Rice and GJMD Studio, the series brings a fresh take on the short-form horror format to Tubi previously explored in Hulu's Bite Size Halloween. Across the season, grief, ambition, intimacy, and vulnerability become entry points for something darker, as characters searching for connection, control, or a way forward find themselves confronting forces they do not understand. With a new story and a new nightmare in every episode, Bite Size Terror delivers a sharp, unpredictable collection of horror built to unsettle, surprise, and linger long after each story ends.

items.title: Coven Academy
items.synIT: La storia segue un trio di streghe adolescenti e un gruppo di stregoni loro coetanei, alle prese con l'apprendimento della magia e con antichi conflitti sovrannaturali che minacciano la città. In questo elegante collegio, come suggerisce la sinossi ufficiale, il potere è la vera moneta di scambio, i segreti possono rivelarsi letali e innamorarsi della persona sbagliata diventa un rischio concreto.
items.synEN: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, Coven Academy follows three teenage witches and their dangerously charming warlock peers at an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability. Caught between ancient supernatural wars and forbidden love interests, the coven must decide how far they're willing to go to protect their city—and themselves.

items.title: Kill Jackie
items.synEN: Jackie Price has been living a luxurious existence for the last twenty years – travelling the world, selling fine art using sophisticated tax loopholes, and, above all, trying to stay anonymous after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life starts to feel a little boring, it takes a sudden lethal turn when she discovers The Seven Demons, a squad of the world's most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her. Assuming someone from her past is behind it, Jackie unleashes her old instincts and embarks on a wild, dangerous game plan: to take down The Demons one by one before they kill her. However, she soon realises her own demons are much more terrifying than the ruthless killers on her trail... and her buried secrets ultimately lead her much closer to home, with surprising consequences.

items.title: Reina Roja
items.synIT: Antonia Scott è la donna più intelligente al mondo, diventata la Regina Rossa di un progetto della polizia. Dopo aver lasciato il servizio a causa di un provvedimento disciplinare, il poliziotto basco e gay, Jon Gutiérrez, rivoluziona la sua vita e i suoi metodi in un appassionante doppio caso di rapimento e omicidio.
items.synEN: With an IQ of 242, Antonia Scott is officially the smartest person on Earth. Her intelligence made her the "Red Queen" of a secret and experimental police project, but what seemed like a gift became a curse, and she ended up losing everything. When the son of a powerful tycoon is found gruesomely murdered and the daughter of Spain's wealthiest man is kidnapped, the Red Queen organization is set in motion. Mentor, Antonia's former boss, turns to Jon Gutiérrez, a hot-tempered Basque cop on the verge of being expelled from the force, to reactivate Antonia. The twisted cat-and-mouse game in which Jon and Antonia become entangled in during the investigation helps them discover that they admire and complement each other almost as much as they irritate each other. Reina Roja is a haunting thriller set in Madrid, a city that plays a central role to the story, that combines the urgency and action of the investigation with the juicy and witty chemistry between its two main characters.

items.title: The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd
items.synIT: Questa serie incredibilmente divertente e intelligente fa emergere una bizzarra raffica di persone, luoghi, oggetti ed eventi più strani della storia umana e racconta storie in un modo che solo Aykroyd può fare.
items.synEN: Did you know that a brown bear became a war hero for the Allies during WWII? Or that a flying lawnmower once killed a spectator at a football game? What about the story of the 19th century doctor who ate vomit to understand how yellow fever is transmitted?If you haven't, then brace yourself for The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd.Each hour-long episode will open up our cabinet of curiosities to reveal the strangest-but-true stories in human history, brought to life through dynamic recreation, compelling graphics, and arresting archival. These seemingly tall tales all actually happened, and our cast of experts dives into the historical record to tell you how and why.It's a bizarro barrage of people, places and events that prove just how weird our world can be.

items.title: Ferret-Man
items.synEN: After buying a video game from a yard sale, a kid inputs a cursed cheat code that sends the character out of the game, seeking freedom.

items.title: Untitled Cat Commercial
items.synEN: A commercial for cat treats that cause lasers to shoot from the feline’s eyes to stop home invaders.

items.title: Bonkey: The Mutated
items.synEN: An alien disease spreads like wildfire infecting a chain of unsuspecting victims. A man and his dog are all that stand in the way of containing the danger.

items.title: The Fall of Barsisa
items.synEN: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

items.title: Hinter
items.synEN: A Deaf American backpacker finds himself stranded in the depths of the German Black Forest, hunted by something unknown. Stumbling upon a rural farmstead, he finds a guarded German farmer who knows no English. With a language barrier dividing them, the backpacker must discern whether this stranger is a lifeline or the threat.

items.title: Too Tight to Move
items.synEN: A young traveler tries out a brand-new, top of the line massage chair.

items.title: The Influencer Project
items.synEN: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

items.title: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
items.synEN: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

items.title: Appofeniacs
items.synEN: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

items.title: Infirmary
items.synEN: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

items.title: Il risveglio di Boiúna
items.synIT: Un gruppo di giovani medici impegnato a portare assistenza sanitaria nei villaggi più remoti dell’Amazzonia è costretto a fuggire nella giungla dopo un violento scontro con alcuni uomini coinvolti nella costruzione di una strada. Ma nelle profondità della foresta li attende una minaccia ancora più terrificante: Boiúna, un gigantesco serpente leggendario che sembra essere molto più di una semplice creatura del folklore. Braccati in un ambiente estremo e implacabile, i protagonisti dovranno lottare per sopravvivere contro un predatore che domina la giungla da milioni di anni.
items.synEN: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

items.title: War
items.synEN: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.

items.title: Lo squalo 2
items.synIT: Ancora una volta la spiaggia di Amity Bay è minacciata da un gigantesco squalo cacciatore di uomini. Ancora una volta lo sceriffo Brody (Roy Scheider) cerca di dare l’allarme e ancora una volta le autorità, per motivi economici, tendono a non dargli retta provocando così altro terrore.
items.synEN: Police chief Brody must protect the citizens of Amity after a second monstrous shark begins terrorizing the waters.

items.title: The House Party Massacre
items.synEN: 8 partying friends are Violently killed by a killer

items.title: Insanity
items.synEN: 7 friends go on a camping trip after a year of not seeing each other. Everything is going well until a killer wielding a sword and bow comes to join the party...

items.title: Senseless Acts of Violence 2
items.synEN: Haunted by the aftermath of a camping trip gone wrong, Topher is drawn into a brutal and increasingly surreal world where unseen forces pull the strings—and his understanding of reality begins to fall apart.

items.title: Red Egg of the Crimson King
items.synEN: In a dilapidated apartment drowned in the oppressive hum of electricity, a man kills his evenings by watching, through a hole in the wall, an empty stage bathed in childish music. This strange routine brings him a fragile joy.  But one evening, something appears: an egg-shaped object marked with a face. An enigmatic presence. An angel… God?

items.title: Pit Of Bones
items.synEN: 4 Friends go camping and get put into The Pit of Bones

items.title: The Substance
items.platform: Arrivo su HBO Max Amazon Channel
items.synIT: Hai mai sognato una versione migliore di te? Tu. Semplicemente, migliore, in ogni senso. Davvero. Devi provare questo nuovo prodotto. Si chiama “la sostanza”. HA CAMBIATO LA MIA VITA. Genera un altro te. Un te nuovo, più giovane, più bello, più perfetto. E c’è solo una regola: vi dovete dividere il tempo. Una settimana sta a te. Quella dopo sta al nuovo te. Sette giorni a testa. Un equilibrio perfetto. Facile, no? Se rispetti l’equilibrio… cosa può andare storto?
items.synEN: A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.

items.title: Multiple Choice
items.synEN: A group of students are killed off one by one after writing a multiple choice exam. One of them is the killer...

items.title: Erie
items.synEN: Siblings Stella and Oscar return to their Pennsylvania hometown to investigate their sister Iris' unexplained death following a mysterious rise in suicides within the county.

items.title: CAPTURED
items.synEN: Andy, a stressed and obsessive wildlife photographer desperate for a competition-winning shot, sets out alone into the woods where his anxiety, lack of medication, and mounting frustration blur the line between ambition and self-destruction.

items.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
items.synEN: Introducing a new visual approach to true crime storytelling, Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos presents next generation visualizations of documented first-person accounts from Wuornos, those close to her, and the investigators who worked the case, accounts previously available only in verified transcripts, documented evidence, and chronicled firsthand testimony. The series brings a new dimension to the story of Wuornos and the investigation that brought her to justice - through the perspectives of those who lived it.

items.title: Beyond the Dark Veil
items.synEN: A psychic with her own social media show enters a possessed house. Horror ensues.

items.title: Camp Duval
items.synEN: Welcome to Camp Duval, the wildest comedy camp ever created — where rising comics come to sharpen their jokes, survive the chaos, and hopefully make it through the night.

items.title: Grimsburg
items.synIT: Marvin Flute, che potrebbe essere il più grande detective di sempre, ha un mistero che non riesce ancora a decifrare: la sua famiglia seguirà ogni pista che ha per riscattarsi con l'ex moglie che non ha mai smesso di amare.
items.synEN: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack - his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute will follow every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know.

items.title: The Vampires of New Orleans
items.synEN: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

items.title: Bagman
items.synIT: Per secoli e in tutte le culture, i genitori hanno messo in guardia i loro figli dal leggendario Bagman, che rapisce bambini innocenti e li infila nella sua borsa vile e putrida, per non essere mai più visti. Patrick McKee è sfuggito per un pelo a un simile incontro da ragazzo, che gli ha lasciato cicatrici indelebili per tutta la sua età adulta. Ora, il tormentatore d'infanzia di Patrick è tornato, minacciando la sicurezza di sua moglie Karina e del figlio Jake.
items.synEN: For centuries and across cultures, parents have warned their children of the legendary Bagman, who snatches innocent children and stuffs them into his vile, rotting bag—never to be seen again. Patrick McKee narrowly escaped such an encounter as a boy, which left him with lasting scars throughout his adulthood. Now, Patrick’s childhood tormentor has returned, threatening the safety of his wife Karina and son Jake.

items.title: Family
items.synEN: Watching her sick father decline, 11-year-old Johanna makes a call for a good spirit to save him. But something else comes instead.

items.title: Never After Dark
items.synEN: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

items.title: Backrooms
items.synIT: Se non fai attenzione e superi la barriera della realtà, entrerai nelle backrooms. Se finisci lì dentro, resta vigile, perché i passi che echeggiano in quelle stanze potrebbero non essere solo i tuoi…
items.synEN: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

items.title: The Other Ones
items.synEN: Invoking the wrath of an ancient terror, a mother and daughter must rely on one another to confront the trauma that has plagued their family over generations.

items.title: Nightmare School – The Mystery of Professor Marabecca
items.synEN: Set in the imposing Kaiser Academy—a private boarding school that looks like something out of a Gothic novel—*Nightmare School* tells the story of Vittoria’s inexplicable disappearance.
