A group of friends—Isa, Michi, and Gibbo—join forces to search for her, discovering that the school is far more than a place of learning: it is steeped in legend, a guardian of dangerous secrets, and presided over by an authoritarian headmistress who is the heir to a shadowy alchemist founder…

items.title: Buzzkill
items.synEN: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

items.title: Hellbilly Hollow
items.synEN: A team of paranormal YouTubers venture deep into the Alabama backwoods to film at a haunted attraction the day before Halloween. They encounter a sinister presence far more frightening - and deadlier - than specters and staged scares: Tickles and his caretaker brother Bull. One by one, the investigators, together with local thrill-seekers, fall victim!

items.title: Balaraw
items.synEN: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

items.title: American Horror Story
items.synIT: American Horror Story è una serie antologica prodotta da FX. Ogni stagione racconta una storia autoconclusiva legata al genere horror, esplorando argomenti e sottogeneri come lo slasher, la casa infestata dagli spettri, la stregoneria, il satanismo, il manicomio e persino l’elezione presidenziale del 2016. Il cast rimane parzialmente invariato ogni anno, dando agli attori la possibilità di interpretare più ruoli. Anche se ogni ciclo di episodi è tecnicamente a sé stante, personaggi di una stagione specifica possono apparire in un’altra, dato che tutte le storie si svolgono nel medesimo universo. In particolare, l’ottava stagione è un vero e proprio crossover tra la prima e la terza.
items.synEN: American Horror Story is an horror television anthology series. Each season is conceived as a self-contained miniseries, following a disparate set of characters and settings, and a storyline with its own beginning, middle, and end. While some actors appear for more than one year, they play completely different roles in each season.

items.title: The Hunted
items.synEN: After their boat capsizes in the Mediterranean Sea, a group of refugees are rescued by rich Europeans who offer them shelter on an idyllic island. But the miracle soon becomes a nightmare when the saviors turn into ruthless manhunters.

items.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
items.synEN: A group of vampires confronts the challenges of adapting to contemporary society while grappling with their own mortality, all while engaged in a conflict with a dangerous enemy.

items.title: insomn
items.synEN: Somn Moon, an overworked office worker, ends another monotonous day and dreams of a window embedded in his chest: an eerie portal into his unconscious. Inside, he encounters a haunting replica of himself.

items.title: The Swallow
items.synEN: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

items.title: Psycho Killer
items.synEN: Following the brutal murder of her husband, a Kansas highway patrol officer sets out on a journey to track down the perpetrator. As the hunt progresses, she comes to realize the man responsible is a sadistic serial killer, and the depth of his mental depravity and his sinister agenda is more twisted than anyone could have imagined.

items.title: Where Darkness Dwells
items.synEN: Assigned to a missing person case, reporter Trish Bostwick follows the trail to a secluded asylum hidden in the New England woods, but everything changes when a knife-wielding stranger hijacks her car, plunging her into a descent of paranoia and madness.

items.title: Lenore
items.synEN: When a controversial influencer suddenly disappears, a terminally online sycophant goes hunting for answers, but comes face-to-face with the monstrosity of his own sins.

items.title: Mr. Creamjeans' Hidey Hole
items.synEN: Henry, a man plagued by chronic pain and unresolved guilt, receives a chilling message: "I know what you did." The note leads him to The Hidey Hole, an underground museum of erotic nightmares, curated by the charismatic and unsettling Mr. Creamjeans. There, Henry is offered a chance to erase all traces of his secret crime... but only if he submits to a guided tour of the museum's most depraved exhibits. With every tale, Henry's pain worsens and his grip on reality slips, until he's forced to confront the twisted role he's played in the lives (and deaths) of others. By the end, Henry must decide: confess the truth and face the consequence, or lose himself to the Hidey Hole forever.

items.title: Terms & Conditions
items.synEN: A douchey techbro gets more than he bargained for when the genderqueer demon he used AI to summon sloughs off his control and sows chaos instead.

items.title: American Hostage
items.synEN: The first 8-episode installment of this anthology series is set in the 1970s. The psychological thriller tells the harrowing true story of Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter who is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

items.title: Stitches
items.synEN: A chilling psychological body horror anthology in which three isolated men submit to rituals of healing – an AI cleanse, a livestream of penance, and an experimental drug trial – each descending into madness as their pain becomes performance in a world obsessed with watching.

items.title: Strange Spirits
items.synEN: In a haunted roadside bar run by the mysterious Ghoulian Madman, a series of twisted horror stories unfold, from cursed video games and alien body snatchers to killer clowns and supernatural nightmares, proving every spirit has a story.

items.title: Faceless
items.synIT: Ever since the invisible presence of No-Face began to dwell on the fine line between people’s unconscious and subconscious minds, pangs of conscience have intensified. No-Face compels one to look deeply within, into the most remote recesses of the soul's code.  Da quando l'invisibile presenza di SenzaFaccia ha iniziato ad aleggiare sul confine sottile tra l'inconscio e il subconscio delle persone, i rimorsi della coscienza si sono fatti più acuti. Costringe a guardarsi dentro a fondo, fin nei più remoti recessi del codice dell'anima.

items.title: luzid
items.synEN: The nightmare-plagued protagonist attempts to use lucid dreaming to break free from a surreal cycle.

items.title: TEENAGERS
items.synEN: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

items.title: Goody Goody
items.synEN: Lulled into a necessary sense of comfort during a long home birth process, expecting parents and their midwife begin to realize that something may be horribly wrong. As labor complications ensue, a blizzard rages outside trapping the family in their home – sitting ducks for whatever sinister presence might be in there with them.

items.title: Resident Dead
items.synEN: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

items.title: Play House
items.synEN: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a young man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired TV show in the basement. But as the show’s dark history surfaces, it seeps into his life, threatening his last chance at reconciliation.

items.title: Resident Evil
items.synIT: Bryan, un corriere medico, si ritrova involontariamente coinvolto in una frenetica sfida contro il tempo per sopravvivere, mentre una notte sconvolgente e orribile sprofonda nel caos intorno a lui.
items.synEN: Bryan, a medical courier, unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

items.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
items.synEN: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story tells the story of how one young woman changed what the world believed a killer could be... all it took was an axe.When the repressed daughter of a wealthy New England family and her rebellious maid find themselves trapped in a house built on humiliation and cruelty, they escape into a fantasy of sex, power, and revenge. The gruesome unsolved murders that follow don't just shock the world—they give birth to an icon who refuses to live imprisoned in a cage, choosing instead to forge her own legend: shocking, monstrous, and gloriously free.

items.title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
items.synIT: Hawkins, inverno 1985. Bentornati in una città piena di segreti, dove l'amato gruppo di eroi affronta altri misteri... e nuovi strani fenomeni.
items.synEN: In the winter of 1985, snow blankets the town and the horrors of the Upside Down are finally fading. Our heroes Eleven, Mike, Will, Dustin, Lucas, and Max have settled back into a normal life of D&D, snowball fights, and quiet days. But beneath the ice, something terrifying has awakened. Could it be from the Upside Down? From the depths of Hawkins Lab? Or from somewhere else entirely? Our heroes must race to solve this mystery and save Hawkins in this new story set in the Stranger Things universe.

items.title: Bloody Tennis
items.synEN: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

items.title: I Have Proof
items.synEN: Plot details are being kept locked in an old VCR, but the film is said to be psychologically charged, and favor 'texture, imperfection, and immediacy over polish'.

items.title: HALF
items.synEN: Twin half-blooded vampires wage war with desert highway hijackers

items.title: The Class: Online
items.synEN: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

items.title: Jollyface
items.synEN: The  movie follows a woman investigating a murder while being hunted in her apartment building.

items.title: The Cycle
items.synEN: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

items.title: The Face of Horror
items.synEN: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

items.title: FLAPJAX
items.synEN: An over-eager fast-food manager is tasked with reviving a highly addictive menu item called "FLAPJAX" to save his fast-food company from bankruptcy. He pulls his estranged mother, a faded pop-star known as Popo, out of retirement to promote the item. However, he soon becomes ensnared by the company's true intentions and his deeply rooted mommy issues.

items.title: Godmother
items.synEN: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

items.title: City of Blood
items.synEN: Berlin – a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: vampires are determined to seize political power – and blood has become the city's new currency.

items.title: AUFTRAG
items.synEN: A scarred survivor struggles between choices that blur dream and reality, each step pulling him deeper into his own downfall.

items.title: The Difficult Bride
items.synEN: Novera, a bride-to-be in present-day Dhaka, is in love with her groom and dreams of a fairytale wedding, but secretly struggles with her body’s resistance to wedding rituals. As stress and emotional pain intensify, a mysterious woman with long hair begins appearing in Novera’s imagination.

items.title: Alien Spa
items.synEN: Three siblings, grieving the death of their parents, have a spa day from hell (or shall we say... from space).

items.title: The Creep Tapes
items.synIT: Esplora una raccolta di videocassette di un serial killer che ingaggia le vittime con false pretese per filmarlo. Ogni episodio presenta una nuova vittima. Esplora una raccolta di videocassette di un serial killer che ingaggia le vittime con false pretese per filmarlo.
items.synEN: The Creep Tapes is a collection of video tapes from the secret vault of the world's deadliest and most socially uncomfortable serial killer. Unravel a twisted mind as he lures victims to film his life, only to reveal his deadly intentions.

items.title: INT3RV1EW
items.synEN: A teenage boy's ordinary day takes a surreal turn when he goes to a routine job interview. Living with his roommate, he expects a simple experience, until the interview takes a dark turn.  Crafted by rising Australian filmmakers G31 Productions, this short film blends horror, thrills, and twists, leaving audiences questioning what’s real.

items.title: P A L A C E
items.synEN: New Orleans’ beloved Historic Palace Theatre is set for demolition, when the supervisor behind the project discovers why it closed down from the souls lost inside.

items.title: The Summoning of the Great Lemon
items.synEN: A very picky eater looks through a strange cookbook he found and looks on how to summon a demon, instead he summons a lemon. The lemon will be very violent and will blow stuff up...

items.title: The Phone Booth
items.synEN: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

items.title: Steamboat Killie
items.synEN: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

items.title: Something Beautiful - Quelque chose de beau
Kopis
items.synIT: Francesca, una ragazza inquieta e insoddisfatta nonostante la sua bellezza, decide di riunire alcuni suoi amici nella casa dei suoi genitori fuori città. Ma quella che avrebbe dovuto essere solo una spensierata vacanza all'insegna di sesso e droga si trasforma presto in un terribile incubo senza fine, quando all'improvviso un individuo mascherato e armato di un antico pugnale sacrificale comincia a profilarsi con la sua follia omicida.
items.synEN: Francesca, a young woman seeking lighthearted relaxation, joins her friends at the family estate for a night of fun. But what begins as a carefree game quickly turns into a nightmare.

items.title: Exit Only
items.synEN: Cade hears about strange noises coming from one of his theater exits.

items.title: The Werefish
items.synEN: A man seeks the help of an expert when their roommate starts acting a bit fishy.

items.title: Countryside
items.synEN: Estranged brothers, Sean and Luke, return to their rural childhood home. When a zombie outbreak throws the world into chaos, they have no choice but to confront the sacrifices they are willing to make for family.

items.title: Almost Afraid
items.synEN: Simon Britton, documentarian and skeptic, visits Brisbane's most haunted house to investigate reports of paranormal activity.

items.title: Tainted Blood
items.synEN: A vampire is overwhelmed by her greed of blood.

items.title: Mārama
items.synIT: 1859. Quando una giovane donna Māori viene chiamata dalla Nuova Zelanda nel North Yorkshire, scopre la sua orribile eredità coloniale ed è costretta ad affrontare e distruggere l'inglese titolato che ha devastato la sua famiglia.
items.synEN: 1859. When a young Māori woman is summoned from New Zealand to North Yorkshire, she uncovers her horrific colonial heritage and is compelled to confront and destroy the titled Englishman who devastated her family.

items.title: Pussy Gets Bit!
items.synEN: In an underground drag-wrestling scene, Pussy The Insane Clown, a flamboyant T-boy performer, faces off against their ex, CatRatBat, a feral and enigmatic wrestler. Still grappling with unresolved feelings, their rivalry spills into the ring, blending punk theatrics with raw emotional tension. With the sharp-tongued Red Hot Rhonda hyping up the crowd, the match becomes a wild spectacle of love, pain, and performance.

items.title: Gator Face
items.synEN: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

items.title: Don't Move
items.synEN: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

items.title: El nido
items.synEN: Marta, a woman so obsessed with protecting her family from outside danger that she decides to keep her mother and young son locked away in an isolated house high in a mountain village.

items.title: Mindflip
items.synEN: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

items.title: The Possession of Michael King
items.synEN: The film tells the story of documentary filmmaker Michael King (Shane Johnson), who doesn’t believe in God or the Devil. Following the sudden death of his wife, Michael decides to make his next film about the search for the existence of the supernatural, making himself the center of the experiment – allowing demonologists, necromancers, and various practitioners of the occult to try the deepest and darkest spells and rituals they can find on him – in the hopes that when they fail, he’ll once and for all have proof that religion, spiritualism, and the paranormal are nothing more than myth. But something does happen. An evil and horrifying force has taken over Michael King. And it will not let him go.

items.title: Hellcat
items.synEN: A woman wakes in the back of a moving camper trailer with a badly infected wound. A voice from the truck towing it tells her they must reach a doctor within the hour or she’ll suffer a horrific fate.

items.title: Demeter - Il risveglio di Dracula
items.synIT: Basato su un agghiacciante capitolo del romanzo cult di Bram Stoker, Dracula.  Demeter: Il Risveglio di Dracula racconta la terrificante storia della nave mercantile Demeter, noleggiata per trasportare cinquanta casse di legno non contrassegnate da Carpathia a Londra.  Strani eventi si abbattono sull'equipaggio mentre cerca di sopravvivere al lungo viaggio, perseguitato ogni notte da una presenza inquietante a bordo della nave.  Quando la Demeter arriva finalmente al largo delle coste inglesi, è un relitto carbonizzato e abbandonato.  Dell'equipaggio non c'è traccia.
items.synEN: The crew of the merchant ship Demeter attempts to survive the ocean voyage from Carpathia to London as they are stalked each night by a merciless presence onboard the ship.

items.title: River
items.synEN: After being stranded in a boat on a country river, three siblings are stalked by a faceless killer.

items.title: Domeownation
items.synEN: A cat performs a satanic ritual to dominate the world.

items.title: Stuffed
items.synEN: Araminta, a brooding taxidermist whose secret ambition is to stuff a human specimen, meets Bernie, a lonely man so afraid of being forgotten that he volunteers himself, their pact unexpectedly evolves into a haunting romance.

items.title: Wolf Ticket
items.synEN: A down on his luck man purchases the secret to success: a ticket that turns the buyer into a werewolf.

items.title: Something Seems Off
items.synEN: A group of three teenage boys decide to go ghost hunting in their friends backyard, and when things go wrong there is nobody they can trust.

items.title: Voices in my Head
items.synEN: Recently, a tragedy deeply shook the siblings Sarah and Kevin. Their parents died in a car accident. Sarah suffers greatly from the loss. She is convinced that her parents were murdered by a creepy woman who haunts their home. Increasingly, Kevin must realize that his sister is in great danger.

items.title: La Bête du Gévaudan
items.synEN: During a stormy night, the mayor of the town hears a noise at the door...

items.title: The Spirit Lock
items.synEN: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

items.title: Biff the Human Slayer
items.synEN: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

items.title: Khom Khlang
items.synEN: Bulan, a woman with a mysterious aura, crosses paths with Peem, a police officer desperate to solve a case for which the law offers no answers. Recommended as the only one capable of helping her, Bulan awakens in Peem doubts, attraction, and an unexpected bond that will challenge her beliefs and her understanding of justice.

items.title: Peta Joy In... I'm Not A Lesbian
items.synEN: Growing tired of her mediocre DL Trade, Peta Joy retreats into homoerotic female friendships while refusing to admit she's a lesbian.

items.title: Goodbye, Monster
items.synEN: A 12-year-old boy receives one final visit from the creature under his bed, forcing him to confront fear, loss, and the emotional cost of growing up.

items.title: Crawl - Intrappolati
items.synIT: La storia di una giovane donna che si ritrova intrappolata nella sua abitazione, mentre all'esterno impazza un uragano di categoria 5. La ragazza non solo dovrà tentare di salvare suo padre, ma anche fare i conti con il livello dell'acqua che cresce sempre più all'interno della casa, attirando gli alligatori della zona.
items.synEN: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

items.title: Halloween Bird
items.synEN: On Halloween night, a deaf girl and her grandmother carve pumpkins and wait for trick-or-treaters. They are about to receive a menacing visitor.

items.title: Be My Darling
items.synIT: C’è un luogo dove la carta da parati si stacca dai muri e la moquette nasconde macchie che nessuno vuole vedere. Lei sogna la fuga, lui sogna che resti. “Be My Darling” è un incubo breve e feroce, dove l'amore si confonde con la possessione e la fuga diventa impossibile.
items.synEN: Behind faded wallpaper and a red carpet hiding stains, a girl awakens into silence. She longs to escape; he longs to keep her. "Be My Darling" is a dark, unsettling vision where the fragile line between love and possession becomes a trap with no way out.

items.title: BALL PIT
items.synEN: A father haunted by a childhood trauma is forced to confront his worst nightmare when a ball pit appears at his daughter's birthday party.

items.title: Big Shark
items.synEN: Three firefighters must save New Orleans from a gigantic shark.

items.title: Parasomnia
items.synEN: After her friend vanishes, Riley must confront the demon from her night terrors that may have crossed into reality, while facing her own tragic past.

items.title: Ever After
items.synEN: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

items.title: DIVINE MACHINERY
items.synEN: After a rookie cop's friend seemingly walks off the face of the Earth, he goes searching for him, leading him to a compound that believes you can talk directly to God through a technological Tower.

items.title: Black Box
items.synEN: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

items.title: The Atlas Field
items.synIT: Affetto da una malattia terminale, Daniel convince suo fratello Henry ad accompagnarlo sulla cima di una montagna che avevano visitato insieme da bambini. Il suo obiettivo è semplice: porre fine alla propria sofferenza. Intorno all’area si estende un misterioso progetto gestito dalla società privata Sirevo, che continua a sollevare interrogativi senza risposta mentre nel bosco vengono segnalati fenomeni inspiegabili. Man mano che si avvicinano alla vetta, il viaggio dei due fratelli si trasforma gradualmente in un confronto con una realtà che sembra sfidare ogni spiegazione, in un luogo dove il passato potrebbe non essere mai davvero scomparso.
items.synEN: Afflicted by a terminal illness, Daniel convinces Henry to accompany him to the summit of a mountain they visited together during childhood. But their journey takes a dark turn as they enter the wilderness surrounding a mysterious project run by Sirevo, a secretive private corporation whose local operations have sparked intense scrutiny.  As unexplained phenomena multiply throughout the forest, the brothers are forced into a confrontation with an environment that defies explanation — a place where the rules of time bend, and the past may never have truly disappeared.

items.title: She Saw Us
items.synEN: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

items.title: THE BOX
items.synEN: Living alone in an isolated rural cabin, Max’s quiet routine is disturbed when a mysterious wooden box appears on his doorstep containing an old photograph of his home. After throwing it away, the box inexplicably returns  and with it comes a series of increasingly disturbing events. As Max begins to realise he may not be alone, he finds himself caught in a sinister cycle that has haunted the cabin long before he arrived.

items.title: Late Night At The Movies
items.synEN: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

items.title: Spiral
items.synEN: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

items.title: Chronovisor
items.synEN: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

items.title: CHAT
items.synEN: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

items.title: Final Transmissions
items.synEN: Final Transmissions is an upcoming six-episode analog horror anthology series that features six short, found-footage films, set to be created using analog technology and VHS tapes to evoke a '90s television aesthetic.

items.title: Dark Hollow
items.synEN: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

items.title: Il patto dei lupi
items.synIT: Verso la fine del 1700 nella zona meridionale della Francia accadde un fatto che fece epoca, tramandato poi nei decenni con le dovute licenze di fantasia e di leggenda. Fu lo stesso re Luigi XV a dare ordine che il mistero venisse risolto. Circa centotrenta persone erano state trovate uccise e massacrate. Presto si capì che l'assassino non era un umano ma un animale, chiamato appunto "la bestia di Gévaudon". Per la caccia al mostro non basta l'esercito, ci vogliono degli specialisti, ed eccoli: Grégoire de Fronsac (Le Bhin), una sorta di Indiana Jones d'epoca, e Mani (Dacascos) un indiano mistico e ottimo combattente.
items.synEN: In 18th century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent by the King to the Gevaudan province to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

items.title: Attack of the Kraken
items.synEN: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.

items.title: Presence
items.synIT: Una coppia, Rebekah e Chris, e i loro figli, Tyler e Chloe, si trasferiscono in una casa di periferia apparentemente normale. Quando accadono strani eventi, iniziano a credere che ci sia qualcos'altro in casa con loro. La presenza sta per sconvolgere le loro vite in modi inimmaginabili.
items.synEN: A couple and their children move into a seemingly normal suburban home. When strange events occur, they begin to believe there is something else in the house with them. The presence is about to disrupt their lives in unimaginable ways.

items.title: Smile 2
items.synIT: Sul punto di iniziare un nuovo tour mondiale, la star internazionale del pop Skye Riley (Naomi Scott) inizia a vivere esperienze sempre più terrificanti e incomprensibili. Schiacciata dalle crescenti angosce e dalle pressioni della notorietà, Skye è costretta a confrontarsi con il suo passato oscuro per riprendere in mano la sua vita prima che vada in pezzi.
items.synEN: About to embark on a new world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her dark past to regain control of her life before it spirals out of control.

items.title: Alone
items.synIT: Quando la sedicenne Leila si sveglia una mattina, scopre che tutti sono misteriosamente scomparsi. Pensando di essere l'unica sopravvissuta a qualche inspiegabile disastro, scopre ben presto che ci sono altri quattro adolescenti.
items.synEN: Five kids wake up in a world where everybody has disappeared.

items.title: More Beautiful Than Death
items.synEN: And death and life she hated equally, And nothing saw, for her despair, But dreadful time, dreadful eternity, No comfort anywhere

items.title: Die Nacht der leitenden Reichen
items.synEN: The wealthy Fritz Februar abducts homeless people right of the streets. And his newest invention, the Zombeer, will take his hate for homeless people even further. This absurd invention turns it's victims into mindless zombies, once they die. But Wizzy Wendy and Beatrix Fulci are ready to fight Fritz and his undead henchmen, whatever it takes...

items.title: You Must Be Rachel
items.synEN: Wanting to fulfill her final request, a mother hires an escort for her terminally-ill underage daughter.

items.title: 28 giorni dopo
items.synIT: Inghilterra, oggi. Durante un blitz un gruppo di animalisti irrompe in un laboratorio dove alcuni scimpanzè vengono sottoposti alla visione forzata di immagini violente. Il ricercatore che studia le cavie avverte gli attivisti che gli animali sono affetti da un virus sconosciuto e pericoloso. Malgrado ciò, i membri del commando decidono di liberare gli animali, da cui vengono immediatamente attaccati. 28 giorni dopo, Jim si risveglia in una Londra deserta e spettrale. La città sembra deserta e Jim vaga alla ricerca di esseri umani. E' solo l'inizio di un'avventura dai risvolti terrificanti, dove l'uomo civilizzato si conferma come la belva peggiore.
items.synEN: Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs -- and it's absolutely impossible to contain.

items.title: The Otherkind
items.synEN: Chaos seeps into a sleepy mountain lake town, as something sinister comes to the surface.

items.title: Paper Crane
items.synEN: An actor takes a stab at recording a self-tape.

items.title: VCR Willie: Tape 3
items.synEN: Part of the unsettling analog horror and found-footage series created by Alexander Henderson (Alexander the Titan). In the series continuity and online releases, Tape 3 corresponds to the chilling segment titled "Mimic," which follows a character named Scarlet and her unsettling experiences with her boyfriend Jared and a mysterious entity.

items.title: Attention
items.synEN: Olivia is an abandoned and insecure teenage girl. Her sister hates her, her dad neglects her and she's lonely. This all changes one day when she spots someone in the cemetery... following her?

items.title: Bite
items.synEN: Bite, directed by Nisma Qureshi, is a short film that focuses on hunger, mental illness, disease and the struggles of anorexia nervosa. It features a young girl, played by Nisma Qureshi, trapped in a room with bare white walls and is only given an air mattress with a pink floral quilt. She is consistently dressed in a floral babydoll dress with light pink ballet flats. The girl is only given an apple to eat, which clearly does not sustain her. She is forcibly wrapped in plastic wrap by The Disease, played by Camryn Halfaker. Eventually  the cycle displayed through the apple starts again, never awarding the young girl peace.

items.title: Fugue
items.synEN: An unnamed protagonist is transported inexplicably into a state of purgatory.

items.title: Deathwoods
items.synEN: A weekend of camping intended to break Scott out of his post breakup depression, quickly turns  into a weekend of bloodshed, as his friends are picked off one by one by the urban legend that haunts the  woods surrounding the small town of Old Hickory, Tennessee.

items.title: The Room Below
items.synEN: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother living with a mysterious creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son. But when a retired detective begins investigating the child's disappearance, her carefully constructed world starts to unravel.

items.title: Plastic Surgery
items.synEN: A doctor on her last day before maternity leave is thrown into a world of chaos when a hidden threat emerges.

items.title: Confinement
items.synEN: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

items.title: Bad Karaoke
items.synEN: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

items.title: LEATHERBACK
items.synEN: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

items.title: Mezarlık
items.synEN: Mezarlık is a dark basement, where a special unit works to solve unsolved murders of women. Commissioner Önem, will have to fight masculine prejudices that support male violence.

items.title: Dark Matter
items.synIT: Jason Dessen si ritrova intrappolato in una versione alternativa della sua vita. Si imbarca in un viaggio tormentoso per tornare dalla sua vera famiglia e salvarla dal nemico più terrificante: lui stesso.
items.synEN: Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels of the decade, Dark Matter is a story about the road not taken. The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.

items.title: Decade of the Dead
items.synEN: Ten years after a worldwide zombie outbreak, a group of sea-faring survivors find refuge with a tropical island community, only to discover a zombie worshiping cult with plans to rule the post-apocalyptic wasteland.

items.title: 742 Evergreen
items.synEN: Two on call police officers respond to a call, where they suspect everything is not what it seems

items.title: Rent in Peace
items.synEN: When a desperate yet lousy landlord drags one of his tenants to evict another tenant from a long-abandoned house he had acquired as a property, the mission turns into a nightmare neither of them can escape.

items.title: Dead Janitors Club
items.synEN: Dead Janitors Club is a dark comedy crime film adapted from Jeff Klima's real-life memoir, The Dead Janitors Club: Pathetically True Tales of a Crime Scene Cleanup King. The story follows crooked cop Dirk (Jake Busey) and his cash-strapped partner Jeff Klima (Felix Merback) as they run a risky, illicit side-hustle cleaning up crime scenes. Things spiral violently out of control when Jeff lifts a mysterious safe from a bloody crime scene, not realizing it belongs to a dangerous drug cartel. At the same time, Jeff falls for Kerry (Brianna Gage), a tattoo artist who is quickly dragged into the crosshairs.

items.title: Electric Meat
items.synEN: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.

items.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
items.synEN: Working as a CIA field agent, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

items.title: Buddy
items.synEN: Remember BUDDY—the bright orange unicorn and star of that classic childrens' television show who brought joy and life lessons into your living room?  Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

items.title: Nervous
items.synEN: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

items.title: MYXOMATOSIS
items.synEN: Harlen’s a young  girl who curiously follows a pair of pink hands through a mirror.  She becomes part of a beautiful world where absolutely everything is controlled by The ominous Man with The Bunnyhead.

items.title: Buyer Beware
items.synEN: A hilarious new horror story by upcoming director ‘Tommy Linguey’ - Coming Soon

items.title: Winnie the Pooh - Sangue e miele
items.synIT: La rivisitazione in chiave horror del classico per bambini di A.A. Milne. Abbandonati da Christopher Robin, Winnie the Pooh e il suo amico Piglet si sono ritrovati a fronteggiare una drastica riduzione di cibo, diventando sempre più affamati e feroci. Presi da una sadica follia, inizieranno a tormentare Christopher e un gruppo di giovani ragazze.
items.synEN: After Christopher Robin abandons them for college, Pooh and Piglet embark on a bloody rampage as they search for a new source of food.

items.title: Bambi - La vendetta
items.synIT: In questa rivisitazione della storia di Bambi, il cervo non è solo addolorato per la morte della madre, ma anche mutato, enorme e con una serie di denti aguzzi e si aggira per i boschi animato da una furia mortale in cerca di vendetta contro gli umani.
items.synEN: After a mother and son get in a car wreck, they soon become hunted by Bambi, a mutated grief-stricken deer on a deadly rampage seeking revenge for the death of his mother and wife.

items.title: Winnie the Pooh - Tutto sangue e niente miele
items.synIT: Cinque mesi dopo gli omicidi, Christopher Robin cerca di tornare alla sua vita normale mentre affronta il suo PTSD. Nel profondo del Bosco dei 100 Acri, cresce una rabbia distruttiva mentre Winnie-the-Pooh, Pimpi, Gufo e Tigro scoprono che la loro casa e le loro vite sono in pericolo dopo che la loro esistenza è stata rivelata.
items.synEN: Five months following the murders, Christopher Robin struggles to maintain a regular life while dealing with PTSD. However, deep within the 100-Acre-Wood, a destructive rage grows as Pooh, Piglet, Owl, and Tigger find their home and their lives endangered after their existence is revealed.

items.title: Turning Point
items.synEN: There is danger in the night, but the true terror is inside the house. Trapped within the home of a zombie in transition, Margot and her partner in crime must find their way out before they become the ghoul’s first victims. Their only hope for survival is a bizarre neighbor with an expert knowledge of the undead and the flicker of humanity remaining in their mutating stalker.

items.title: Peter Pan - Incubo nell'isola che non c'è
items.synIT: Wendy Darling si lancia nel tentativo di salvare suo fratello Michael dalle grinfie del malvagio Peter Pan che intende mandarlo a Neverland. Lungo la strada incontra una contorta Campanellino, che è dipendente da quella che lei pensa sia polvere di fata.
items.synEN: Wendy Darling strikes out in an attempt to rescue her brother Michael from the clutches of the evil Peter Pan who intends to send him to Neverland. Along the way she meets a twisted Tinkerbell, who is hooked on what she thinks is fairy dust.

items.title: Pass the Bottle
items.synEN: A reckless addict is taken on an unexpected journey that forces her to fight for survival.

items.title: Desert Fiends 2
items.synEN: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

items.title: Match
items.synEN: After Paola is matched with a handsome online suitor, she arrives for a first date to discover a house full of dark and terrifying secrets.

items.title: The Andersons
items.synEN: The Andersons is a satirical horror film that begins as a cheerful VHS-era sitcom, following a picture-perfect suburban family. Laugh tracks cue every joke, routines repeat flawlessly, and nothing ever truly changes. That is, until Lisa, the mother, begins to notice something is wrong. Jokes repeat word for word, objects reset, the world seems to glitch, and an unseen audience appears to be watching her every move.  As the cracks begin to show, Lisa steps beyond the sitcom stage and into a void where the making of the show is revealed: cameras, crew, and the presence of an audience. Desperate to escape, she fights her way back into the “show,” only to find the family reset, everyone frozen in their roles while the laughter never stops.  Trapped in an endless loop of artificial happiness, Lisa is left alone with the terrifying realization that awareness is the worst punishment of all.

items.title: Soul Trader
items.synEN: A despondent soul arrives in a strange place where he must confront his (mostly) inner demons.

items.title: It Ends
items.synEN: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

items.title: Camp Miasma - Adolescenza, sesso e morte
items.synIT: Kris è una regista queer di 29 anni che si è fatta conoscere con un film che è un omaggio a Psycho, visto però sotto la prospettiva della tenda della doccia. Ora le viene affidato il reboot di una lunga saga horror, Camp Miasma, il cui capostipite, realizzato negli anni '80, ha avuto un grandissimo successo al box-office. Successivamente però, nei continui rifacimenti, è entrata in crisi. Entusiasta del progetto, cerca di coinvolgere l'attrice che interpretava la ragazza sopravvissuta del primo film, Billy Presley. La donna, da anni, vive reclusa nello stesso luogo dove è stato girato Camp Miasma che si trova nel Pacifico settentrionale, vicino al Canada. Così Kris la raggiunge nella sua dimora per convincerla ad accettare la parte. Billy invita Kris a cena e poi a dormire a casa sua. Da quel momento la regista s'immergerà totalmente nell'atmosfera terrificante della saga e il suo rapporto con Billy si evolverà in modo sorprendente.
items.synEN: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

items.title: Insidious - Fuori dall’Altrove
items.synIT: Gemma, una giovane madre che cresce la figlia nella casa in cui è nata, scopre di poter viaggiare nell'Altrove, il regno-purgatorio delle anime perdute. Quando un'entità malvagia inizia a darle la caccia, Gemma scopre un'abilità che cambia ogni cosa: non si limita solo a entrare nell'Altrove ma può portare ciò che vive lì nel mondo reale. Una volta che i demoni comprendono il suo potere, il nostro mondo diventa il loro terreno di gioco.
items.synEN: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

items.title: Blodsoffer
items.synEN: As endless summer takes its hold over Stockholm, a different kind of darkness sets in. Clean cut, highly regarded Lead Investigator Thomas Berg has a serial killer on his hands. With the brutal murderer targeting his police colleagues, Thomas makes a desperate gamble, turning to a once well-regarded but now out of favour, misanthropic ex-detective for help. His estranged father, Alfred. If they're to stand any chance of protecting their fellow police officers, they must put their differences aside and find a way to work together. Only then will they catch one of the worst killers in Sweden's history.

items.title: Outer Banks
items.synIT: Un affiatato gruppo di adolescenti scopre un segreto sepolto da tempo e scatena una serie di eventi fuori della legalità in un'avventura che non dimenticheranno.
items.synEN: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.

items.title: MACDUFF'D
items.synEN: By the pricking of thy thumbs.

items.title: Enfiévrée
items.synEN: A young girl struggles with the inevitability of adulthood and an unknown illness as malevolent spirits  attempt to prey on her.

items.title: Tape 001
items.synEN: A man is sent into a virtual world, looking for a beneficiant AI that disappeared a few days ago.

items.title: Average Joe
items.synEN: Blue-collar plumber, Joe Washington, discovers his recently deceased father lived a secret, second life and stole millions of dollars from dangerous people just before he died. Now those people think Joe knows where it is. A bloody and violent confrontation triggers a chain of events that force Joe and his close-knit circle of family and friends out of their very average and mundane lives into a life-or-death race against time to find the truth and the millions.

items.title: Expedition X
items.synEN: In Expedition X, Josh Gates joined by scientist Phil Torres and paranormal researcher Heather Amaro to investigate reports of supernatural encounters, mysterious creatures, and astonishing extraterrestrial phenomena. Whether trekking through the remote jungles of Cambodia in search of a legendary ape-man or exploring the secrets of the world's largest cave system right here in the United States, the Expedition X team is taking viewers to the stranger side of the unknown.Making her debut in Expedition X Season 8 is third-generation paranormal investigator Heather Amaro. Amaro notably replaced former host Jessica Chobot, who was one of the main stars of Expedition X for its first seven seasons.

items.title: A Quiet Canopy
items.synEN: Daniel and lifelong friend Noah find themselves lost in the woods. But when Noah begins acting in increasingly disturbing and irrational ways, Daniel can no longer trust his own senses. As reality blurs with delusion, he must decipher what is true, before the forest and his mind consume him completely.

items.title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead
items.synEN: When his brother disappears and everyone forgets he existed, Sam must unravel the mystery before Finn is gone forever.

items.title: Chum: Esca mortale
items.synIT: Una coppia di novelli sposi si unisce ad alcuni amici per un’escursione in yacht nel Mar Mediterraneo, ma si ritrova improvvisamente accerchiata da due minacce che trasformano una vacanza perfetta in una lotta per la sopravvivenza: da una parte uno squalo predatore e dall’altra un assassino psicopatico…
items.synEN: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

items.title: Streaming Killed the Video Store*
items.synEN: An employee is stalked in a video store

items.title: Of Womb
items.synEN: Evading the hard truth of their religious matriarch’s death, three sisters gestate dark ecstasies of faith and folk horror. Blessed be Mother.

items.title: Umthetho
items.synEN: A skilled young public prosecutor is pulled into a brutal prison syndicate led by the brother she thought she lost. Forcing her to choose between justice and family, law and survival, truth and betrayal.

items.title: Connecting to You
items.synEN: Jia Kai has the superpower of seeing the different coloured threads of connection between people but has no connection to anyone himself until a chaotic incident, he meets a policeman named Da Wei and realizes that one silver-grey thread has grown from him to him, connecting them together! Jia Kai doesn't want to lose the connection, so he takes a part-time job at the police station to get closer to Da Wei. With his superpower, he helps with cases of missing people and objects. They get to know each other better, and the thread between them begins to change color, from silver-grey to yellow, representing friendship, and even to red, representing love. Seeing these changes, Jia Kai realizes that how they feel for each other can't be hidden anymore...

items.title: Train to Busan
items.synIT: Seok-wu è un manager finanziario separato dalla moglie: la piccola Su-an spesso si sente trascurata da lui e preferisce la compagnia della madre. Sul treno su cui viaggiano i due, per portare Su-an dalla madre che vive a Busan, sale una ragazza che riporta delle ferite strane sul corpo, simili al morso di un animale. Presto si trasformerà in zombi e sul treno per Busan si scatenerà l'inferno.
items.synEN: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

items.title: Meltdown: A Nuclear Family's Ascension into Madness
items.synEN: A picture-perfect 1950s family throw an important dinner party only for an LSD spiking to upend their plans and expose their festering secrets.

items.title: Abandoned
items.synEN: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

items.title: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies
items.synEN: A gripping documentary series uncovering how organized crime infiltrated Hollywood across the 20th century. As stars and gangsters overlapped, the line between glamour and crime blurred through unions, financing and the hidden power brokers. From early mob influence to later scandals and crackdowns, the series reveals how deeply the underworld shaped the film industry.

items.title: Batman Symbolus: A Fan Film
items.synEN: An exploration of the mythos and symbol of Batman in itself.

items.title: RECORDING #27 - Short Film
items.synEN: A young man records video diaries for therapy, trying to make sense of a past he can’t fully remember. But as he reviews the footage, he begins to notice something unsettling..  What starts as a quiet attempt at healing turns into a slow unraveling, as he realizes a presence has been with him far longer than he thought… and may have never left.

items.title: Las Azules
items.synIT: Nel 1971, quattro donne sfidano le norme ultraconservatrici e si uniscono al primo corpo di polizia femminile del Messico, solo per poi scoprire che si tratta di una trovata pubblicitaria per distrarre l’attenzione dei media da un serial killer. Mentre il numero delle vittime aumenta, stringono il patto di consegnare l’assassino alla giustizia.
items.synEN: Set in 1970 and inspired by true events, Las Azules tells the story of four women who defy the ultra-conservative norms of the time and join Mexico's first female police force, only to discover that their squad is a publicity stunt to distract the media from a brutal serial killer. As the body count grows, María, whose determination to catch the killer becomes an obsession, Gabina, an aspiring officer, Ángeles, a brilliant fingerprint analyst, and Valentina, a young rebel, set up a secret investigation to achieve what no other male officer has been able to do and bring the serial killer to justice.

items.title: Reacher
items.synIT: Quando l'Ufficiale di Polizia Militare in congedo Jack Reacher viene arrestato per un omicidio che non ha commesso, si trova in una cospirazione fatale con poliziotti corrotti, loschi uomini d'affari e politici arrivisti. Con solo il suo ingegno, deve capire cosa sta succedendo a Margrave, Georgia.
items.synEN: Reacher follows Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator who has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served. When Reacher arrives in the small town of Margrave, Georgia, he finds a community grappling with its first homicide in 20 years. The cops immediately arrest him and eyewitnesses claim to place Reacher at the scene of the crime. While he works to prove his innocence, a deep-seated conspiracy begins to emerge, one that will require Reacher's keen mind and hard-hitting fists to deal with. One thing above all is for sure: They picked the wrong guy to take the fall.

items.title: The Boy from Below
items.synEN: On Halloween night, 1997, a masked killer brings slasher films to life in Carpenter Falls. A video store clerk and her friends must survive his deadly game before they’re picked off one by one.

items.title: Sawtooth Mountain
items.synEN: Three college students get entangled in a horrifying ordeal after booking a Bigfoot-themed cabin run by two paranormal-obsessed brothers.

items.title: Harbinger
items.synEN: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

items.title: Popeye IV: Resurrection
items.synEN: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.

items.title: Popeye III: Requiem
items.synEN: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.

items.title: Epitaph
items.synEN: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

items.title: Ash
items.synEN: A young police officer leaves his boyfriend behind and vanishes without a trace. Searching for the truth, his boyfriend discovers that he has become the son-in-law of a mafia boss. Or is he a spy?

items.title: House of Death
items.synEN: At night, a boy is terrorized by a dark latex figure.

items.title: Hollow Girls
items.synEN: On the night of June 2, 2023, a shocking crime shattered a quiet community. Six teenage girls lured one of their classmates into a deadly trap. Fueled by jealousy and a twisted desire for revenge, they set into motion a plan that would end in kidnapping, torture, and murder.

items.title: Eramus
items.synEN: After a romantic interest vanishes without explanation, a woman becomes convinced he is dead. With only her phone as a companion, her katabasis through online spaces leads her to new spiritual languages emerging in a technological age.

items.title: Side Effects May Include...
items.synEN: A group of friends take a trip up to the U.P. for summer vacation. The trip takes a turn when one of them ends up dead.

items.title: Look At This Freak
items.synEN: A reunion of old friends is disrupted by a hated roommate and an internet monstrosity.

items.title: The Latcher
items.synEN: An overworked midwife, hollowed by an unspoken personal tragedy, is haunted by waking nightmares of an eerie presence that creeps from the shadowy bushland into the home where she lost everything.

items.title: Anna Pigeon
items.synEN: Anna Pigeon is a former city slicker who became a park ranger after a devastating loss changed the trajectory of her life forever. While Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds, no matter who or what gets in her way.

items.title: Demon Hunters
items.synEN: Tommy, a YouTuber known for scamming people with his fake exorcism skills, faces a real challenge when he must save his partner, Alumi, from a zombie demon. Teaming up with Sanjay, an Indian exorcist and computer geek determined to avenge his exorcist guru grandfather, Babaji, Tommy must step up. Will they succeed in their mission, and can Sanjay put aside his quest for revenge to work with Tommy?

items.title: Big Baby
items.synEN: A nightmare involving a maniac killer in a baby mask serves as inspiration for horror screenwriter Adam Lewis's new script. As more nightmares, visions, and real life terror being to challenge Adam's sanity, he finds himself in a desperate struggle to control his writing, his reality, and who will be Big Baby's next victim.

items.title: The Cold Tremor Experiment
items.synEN: Five people receive an invitation to a special game show.

items.title: Addiction
items.synEN: After finally building the life he once dreamed of, a young man begins to feel suffocated by the constant effort it takes to maintain it. Exhausted and disillusioned, he starts to lose sight of why he worked so hard in the first place.. As his addiction tightens its grip, his reality begins to fracture. Without the substance, his mind spirals-distorting his perception and isolating him from the world around him. Soon, he starts seeing a dark, shadowy version of himself lurking in the distance... watching, waiting, and slowly getting closer. What begins as an escape turns into a psychological nightmare, as the figure grows impossible to ignore-an eerie manifestation of his unraveling mind, and a haunting reflection of the path he's chosen.

items.title: Namaslay
items.synEN: A reimagining of masala cinema, Namaslay is a pyroclastic, genre-smashing horror satire that eviscerates the appropriation of Yoga in the West—proving culture is the blood that keeps the dead alive.

items.title: Mary Kwon Mary Kwon
items.synEN: A poet travels to her childhood home in the woods, hoping to uncover the cause of her mother's disappearance in the same house. Two visitors unexpectedly drop by.

items.title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
items.synEN: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

items.title: Die Blutgräfin
items.synEN: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

items.title: The Last House
items.synIT: Una famiglia, improvvisamente sigillata all’interno della propria casa, deve collaborare per sopravvivere mentre le risorse scarseggiano e un’inquietante minaccia continua a tenerla prigioniera.
items.synEN: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

items.title: Ice Cream Man
items.synIT: Un'idilliaca cittadina di villeggiatura estiva precipita nell’orrore, quando un gelataio offre ai bambini dolci prelibatezze dalle conseguenze terrificanti.
items.synEN: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

items.title: D.O.P.E. Unit
items.synEN: A covert crime drama set in Philadelphia, following an off-the-books undercover task force known as the D.O.P.E. Unit as it wages a secret war against powerful crime families. As violence escalates and political pressure mounts, the series explores systemic corruption, moral ambiguity, and the consequences of institutional choices in a world where loyalty and justice collide. As the operation deepens, personal lives unravel, trust erodes, and every decision carries a cost that reshapes the mission and those sworn to uphold it.

items.title: Monsters of God
items.synEN: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love – reptiles – into the dark and gonzo underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. The billion-dollar criminal enterprise is fueled by extreme obsession for these creatures, driving many to push the boundaries of laws and environmental ethics. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails. Unfolding over decades, Monsters of God traces the evolution of the reptile trade as it skirts the Endangered Species Act of 1973 and grows into a secretive, high-stakes world of backroom dealings and fanatical collectors. With unprecedented access to the major players, from traffickers to animal enthusiasts to federal agents, Goode unravels a web of larger-than-life characters who run a complex international crime ring. A thrilling exposé of a hidden underworld, Monsters of God warns of the devastating impact of the insatiable desire for the forbidden, and how this mad obsession is pushing some species to the brink of extinction.

items.title: Place of Bones
items.synEN: On a remote ranch, a mother and her daughter fight for survival when a wounded outlaw seeking refuge brings a notorious bank robber and his ruthless gang, all desperate to reclaim a stolen fortune, right to their doorstep.

items.title: Zombies on The Beach
items.synEN: A normal beach trip turned into a disaster.

items.title: The Shards
items.synEN: Set against the vivid backdrop of 1980s Los Angeles, the series follows a group of privileged high school seniors at an elite prep school as they navigate identity, sex, jealousy, obsession and the dangers lurking beneath the surface of American adolescence.

items.title: Angel (iii)
items.synEN: A spectral first-person journey through Los Angeles layers the city across itself as our guide disassociates, giving way to an abstracted daytime ghost story following a woman's splitting of self and perception. ANGEL PROJECT continues.

items.title: Devils Lake
items.synEN: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

items.title: Wired
items.synEN: After undergoing an experimental corpus-brain procedure, a psychiatric patient finds himself struggling to maintain control as his mind becomes entwined with the consciousness of a former subject.

items.title: Down With The Entity's
items.synEN: Henry, a teenager with hallucinations, becomes starving at Two in the morning. His Hallucinations start to take over when a trip downstairs to get a snack turns into risking his life.

items.title: The Chelsea Detective
items.synIT: L'ispettore investigativo Max Arnold vive su una casa galleggiante malconcia alla fine di Cheyne Walk dopo essersi separato dalla moglie mercante d'arte Astrid. Figlio del proprietario di una libreria locale, Max è ben lontano dall'élite benestante di cui aiuterà a risolvere i crimini insieme a D.C. Priya Shamsie.
items.synEN: London's Chelsea neighbourhood is a beautiful borough for beautiful people, but it has a dark underside of deception, violence, greed-and murder. Bodies have a way of showing up, and things are rarely what they seem. DI Max Arnold and his partner must root out the truth and bring those responsible to justice, no matter their wealth or status.

items.title: Zimmer 1408
items.synIT: Il famoso scrittore di libri horror Mike Enslin (John Cusack) crede solo in ciò che può vedere con i propri occhi. Dopo una serie di bestseller che screditano gli eventi paranormali avvenuti nelle case infestate dai fantasmi e nei cimiteri più famosi del mondo, non ha nessuna prova concreta di una vita dopo la morte. La serie di lunghe notti solitarie senza fantasmi di Mike, tuttavia, è destinata a cambiare quando entra nella stanza 1408 del famigerato Dolphin Hotel per il suo ultimo progetto, “Dieci Notti nelle Camere d’Albergo Infestate dai Fantasmi.” Sfidando gli avvertimenti del direttore dell’albergo (Samuel L. Jackson), decide di pernottare – il primo dopo anni - proprio nella stanza che tutti considerano infestata, nella speranza che possa essere l’inizio di un nuovo bestseller. Come molti degli eroi di Stephen King, Mike dovrà affrontare i suoi demoni, passando da scettico a credente, prima di superare la notte...
items.synEN: A man who specializes in debunking paranormal occurrences checks into the fabled room 1408 in the Dolphin Hotel. Soon after settling in, he confronts genuine terror.

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
items.synIT: È passato un anno dall'incubo soprannaturale alla Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. Le storie su ciò che è accaduto lì sono state trasformate in una leggenda locale che ha ispirato il primo Fazfest della città. L'ex guardia di sicurezza Mike (Josh Hutcherson) e l'agente di polizia Vanessa (Elizabeth Lail) hanno nascosto alla sorella undicenne di Mike, Abby (Piper Rubio), la verità sul destino dei suoi amici animatronici. Ma quando Abby sgattaiola fuori per ricongiungersi con Freddy, Bonnie, Chica e Foxy, si scatenerà una serie di eventi terrificanti, che riveleranno oscuri segreti sulla vera origine di Freddy's e sveleranno un orrore a lungo dimenticato e nascosto per decenni.
items.synEN: One year since the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, the stories about what transpired there have been twisted into a campy local legend, inspiring the town's first ever Fazfest. With the truth kept from her, Abby sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, and Foxy, setting into motion a terrifying series of events that will reveal dark secrets about the real origin of Freddy's, and unleash a decades-hidden horror.

items.title: Lioness
items.synIT: La vera storia del Lance Corporal Leslie Martz, un Marine degli Stati Uniti stazionato a Haditha, in Iraq. Martz fu il leader di una squadra formata da donne con il compito di ottenere la fiducia delle donne afgane e di fornirle le abilità necessarie per essere indipendenti e per estrarre segretamente informazioni dai mariti talebani. La Martz nascose di essere una lesbica nell'esercito ed era divisa dal desiderio di provare il suo valore ai suoi superiori e dall'alleanza con le donne e i bambini conosciuti sul luogo.
items.synEN: Lioness, inspired by an actual U.S. Military program, follows the life of Joe while she attempts to balance her personal and professional life as the tip of the CIA's spear in the war on terror. The Lioness Program, overseen by Kaitlyn Meade and Donald Westfield, enlists an aggressive Marine Raider named Cruz to operate undercover alongside Joe among the power brokers of State terrorism in the CIA's efforts to thwart the next 9/11.

items.title: Unknown Serial Killers of America
items.synEN: Each year the FBI estimates between 25 to 50 active serial killers hunt their prey in America, taking the lives of hundreds of innocent people annually. Often these killings keep a city on edge, a heavy fear permeating the night air before these predators are taken off our streets. Just ask those who lived through the terror of The Night Stalker, Son of Sam or The Grim Sleeper. And years later the public still can't seem to get enough of their stories which continue to be retold in documentaries and limited series. Yet for every Jeffrey Dahmer or Ted Bundy who became part of the zeitgeist and remains with us like a dark specter, there are hundreds of other unknown serial killers whose horrific actions were just as terrifying, if not worse. This new series will profile these unknown serial killers who operated in silence. Their murders haunted law enforcement, who were unable to connect all their sick dots, as more innocent lives were lost until the killers were eventually caught.

items.title: Imago
items.synEN: Imago is the experimental odyssey of an trans-dimensional being who lands in the desert and gathers curious specimens. The symbiotic visitor may represent the larval stage of a more developed entity that requires an outside stimulus to complete its metamorphosis - and set it free.

items.title: Soulm8te
items.synEN: After a ruthless tech giant acquires his company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to program her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

items.title: La bambola assassina 2
items.synIT: La mamma di Andy Barclay è stata messa sotto osservazione psichiatrica perché ha sostenuto la storia della bambola assassina, non confermata dalla polizia che non voleva esporsi. Perciò, Andy (Alex Vincent) dovrà essere affidato a un’altra famiglia. La dottoressa Grace Poole (Grace Zabriskie) affida Andy ai coniugi Phil (Gerrit Graham) e Joanne Simpson (Jenny Agutter). L’impatto con la nuova realtà è buono e Andy conosce anche la ribelle Kyle (Christine Elise), una ragazza che vive con i Simpson. Mentre viene trasportato in auto dall’assistente di Sullivan per essere eliminato, Chucky ritorna in azione e, fatto fuori l’assistente, è di nuovo libero e più spietato che mai con il solo scopo di riguadagnare un corpo umano.
items.synEN: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.

items.title: Il culto di Chucky
items.synIT: Rinchiusa in un manicomio criminale da quattro anni, Nica Pierce è erroneamente convinta di essere stata lei - e non la bambola stregata Chucky - ad avere assassinato tutta la sua famiglia. Quando il suo psichiatra introduce un nuovo "strumento" terapeutico per facilitare le sessioni di gruppo dei suoi pazienti (una bambola dal volto innocente e sorridente), una serie di inspiegabili morti iniziano a tormentare la struttura.
items.synEN: Confined to an asylum for the criminally insane for the past four years, Nica is wrongly convinced that she, not Chucky, murdered her entire family... until a string of grisly deaths occur after her psychiatrist introduces a new group therapy tool -- a "Good Guy" doll.

items.title: La bambola assassina 3
items.synIT: Otto anni sono passati e il consiglio di amministrazione della Play Pals Toys rievoca la vicenda di Andy Barclay che aveva portato quasi sul lastrico la ditta con le accuse contro uno dei loro pupazzi “Tipo Bello” (traduzione di “Good Guy”). Adesso, visto il tempo trascorso, gli amministratori ritengono di rimettere in circolazione il bambolotto. Sullivan (Peter Haskell) in persona avalla la decisione. Ma è proprio Sullivan la prima vittima di Chucky, resuscitato e tornato in azione. Chucky, sempre con il pensiero fisso di uscire dal corpo del bambolotto, cerca Andy (Justin Whalin) che adesso è un sedicenne che frequenta una scuola militare.
items.synEN: Eight years after seemingly destroying the killer doll, teen Andy Barclay is placed in a military school, and the spirit of Chucky returns to renew his quest and seek vengeance after being recreated from a mass of melted plastic.

items.title: La maledizione di Chucky
items.synIT: In seguito al suicidio della madre, Nica, sulla sedia a rotelle da quando è nata, è costretta a riunirsi per il funerale con la sorella Barb, il cognato Ian, la nipote Alice e la tata di questa. Quando però la gente che detesta comincia a morire misteriosamente, l'impavida Nica è inorridita dallo scoprire che il colpevole potrebbe essere Chucky, la strana bambola dai capelli rossi ricevuta qualche giorno prima per posta. Ciò che non sa è che Chucky ha da regolare un conto lasciato in sospeso venti anni prima.
items.synEN: After her mother's mysterious death, Nica begins to suspect that the talking, red-haired doll her visiting niece has been playing with may be the key to the mounting bloodshed and chaos.

items.title: Il figlio di Chucky
items.synIT: La Bambola assassina è tornata! È il quinto film della serie horror. Chucky e Tiffany si rtrovano a dover allevare il loro figlio per poter creare una terribile famiglia di bambole assassine.
items.synEN: This time around, Chucky and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then the horror goes Hollywood as Chucky unleashes his own brand of murderous mayhem!

items.title: La sposa di Chucky
items.synIT: Chucky torna nuovamente in vita. Questa volta grazie alla sua ex-fidanzata Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly) che, dopo averlo recuperato e portato nella roulotte dove lei vive, lo ricostruisce (nel film precedente Chucky si tritò su un'elica gigante) dandogli di nuovo vita grazie a poteri voodoo. Con un blitz e con la giusta ispirazione al film La moglie di Frankenstein (che infatti scorre sullo schermo di una TV all'interno della roulotte), Chucky la uccide e ne trasferisce l'anima nel corpo di pezza di una bambola femmina che lei stessa gli aveva regalato per farsi beffa di lui. Dopo di che, tutti e due cominciano a creare una serie di omicidi truculenti, fino a che non trovano due ragazzi, in cui decidono di trasferire le loro anime.
items.synEN: For ten years, the tortured soul of serial killer Charles Lee Ray has been imprisoned inside a child's doll. Chucky is reborn when his old flame, Tiffany, rescues his battered doll parts from a police impound. But Chucky wants his new playmate cut down to size, so he transforms his blushing bride into a stunning little terror. Chucky and Tiffany can't wait to start their own homicidal honeymoon. When this demonic duo hits the road and hooks up with a pair of unsuspecting newlyweds, they leave a trail of murder and mayhem behind them. Chucky's back!

items.title: 28 anni dopo - Il tempio delle ossa
items.synIT: Il dottor Kelson si ritrova coinvolto in una nuova e sconvolgente relazione, con conseguenze che potrebbero cambiare il mondo così come lo conoscono, e l'incontro di Spike con Jimmy Crystal si trasforma in un incubo a cui non può sfuggire.
