items.synEN: Eavesdropping on the life of Sidney Chambers, a charismatic, charming, crime-fighting clergyman, and his partner in crime Police Inspector Geordie Keating, became a highlight for the audience who revelled in their on screen partnership. Geordie's plain-speaking, down to earth approach to policing complemented Sidney's more gentle technique of coaxing information from witnesses and suspects. Their unlikely pairing became a true friendship as each offered a different insight into the crimes they unravelled.

items.title: Cinco botones
items.synEN: An anciet leyend is back to scare a group of history students

items.title: The Columbus Coroner
items.synEN: In an effort to go viral, a struggling true crime YouTuber decides to hunt down an infamous serial killer.

items.title: L'ultimo respiro - Trappola negli abissi
items.synIT: Un gruppo di vecchi amici del college, appassionati di diving, si riunisce per un'immersione ai Caraibi. Il loro scopo è l’esplorazione del relitto della Charlotte, una nave da guerra della seconda guerra mondiale, ma qualcosa va storto. Intrappolati nel labirinto sommerso e arrugginito, si ritrovano circondati da un gruppo di squali. E l’ossigeno è destinato ad esaurirsi…
items.synEN: A group of old college friends reunite on a Caribbean scuba diving trip exploring the wreckage of a WWII battleship and find themselves trapped inside the underwater labyrinth of rusted metal surrounded by great white sharks.

items.title: Power Book III: Raising Kanan
items.synIT: Ambientato a South Jamaica, nel Queens, nel 1991, "Raising Kanan" è un prequel del franchise "Power". È un dramma familiare che ruota attorno alla crescita di Kanan Stark.
items.synEN: Power Book III: Raising Kanan is a prequel story that takes viewers back to the '90s and the early years of iconic Power character Kanan Stark.

items.title: Deep Water
items.synEN: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

items.title: Mancave
items.synEN: Charlotte Husebø is drawn into a labyrinth of repressed fantasies and dark secrets when she discovers that her husband, Didrik Husebø, has a hidden room in the family's garage.

items.title: Peeled Eyes
items.synEN: Joseph is an aspiring illustrator suffering from insomnia. One night at 2:48am, he attempts to reignite his creative spark when he summons an entity that wishes to be completed. Immersed in his new-found motivation, Joseph is blinded by passion and becomes the cost of his own creation.

items.title: Kraken
items.synIT: La biologa marina Johanne sta facendo ricerche in un allevamento ittico a Vangsnes, una comunità rurale situata vicino al fiordo, quando incontra diversi strani eventi. Insieme alla morte brutale di due adolescenti locali, tutti i segni indicano il fiordo profondo; può esserci di più in profondità di quanto l'occhio possa vedere? In fondo al fiordo più profondo riposa un mostro mitico grande come una montagna, con una miriade di braccia pronte a schiacciare e divorare qualsiasi cosa riescano ad afferrare.
items.synEN: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

items.title: The Forest
items.synEN: A filmmaker attempts to make a documentary on a newly opened forest, only to find what’s really in it.

items.title: Lầu Chú Hỏa
items.synEN: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

items.title: Iris Replica
items.synEN: A Puzzle. Triplets are celebrating their birthday. Two are waiting for the return of the third. What they don't know is that the voice outside the door doesn't belong to their brother.

items.title: Instruction pour une Rencontre
items.synEN: The young Abigail receives unsettling instruction from a tutor while awaiting an encounter whose nature she does not yet know.

items.title: Time of Death
items.synEN: Inside an isolated, decaying prison, one man journeys down a sinister, winding path of lies, corruption, and buried secrets.

items.title: The Mountain
items.synEN: The story begins when Kazuno receives a letter from an old friend. The letter says that ever since a group of them tested their courage at an abandoned ruin, a series of strange and disturbing events has begun to occur. Half out of curiosity as part of her research, Kazuno visits the people involved. However, what awaits her is only the beginning of days filled with terror that will eventually consume her as well. One of them dies under mysterious circumstances, and the remaining survivors gradually begin to lose their sanity.

items.title: Whispers of Nature
items.synEN: In the mid-1980s, renowned painter Clarke Holler tells a horrifying story from his life on an episode of his painting show "Whispers of Nature"

items.title: NEW GROUP
items.synEN: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. One day, the people in her school inexplicably start to form a human pyramid. The principal and other teachers start to act weird and encourage taking part in it, and the various gymnastic formations start to spread and take over the whole town. Eventually only Ai and Yuu, a transfer student who finds it hard to fit in, are left to rebel against the conformity madness.

items.title: The Evil Lawyer
items.synEN: When a principled young lawyer becomes the prime accused in the murder of a high-ranking police officer's son, he is forced to team up with the "Evil Lawyer," exploiting every legal loophole to prove his innocence.

items.title: Oranges sanguines
items.synEN: Simultaneously, a retired couple overwhelmed by debt tries to win a dance contest, as the minister of economy is suspected of tax evasion, and a teenage girl encounters a sexual maniac, while a young lawyer attempts to climb the social ladder. When the shoe drops, the winner won’t necessarily be the one we expected.

items.title: We Bury the Dead
items.synEN: After a catastrophic military disaster, the dead don't just rise - they hunt. Ava searches for her missing husband, but what she finds is far more terrifying.

items.title: A Quiet House
items.synEN: SHE’S ALWAYS BEEN AN OLD SOUL Sian and Lewis, are a married couple spend who their days attempting to reach out to their daughter, Hope. Sian brings meals to their room whilst Lewis waits and listens. However, the couple are stuck in a loop that conceals reality. The evening brings warmth and comfort, whilst the harsh morning light reveals the truth of what lies beyond Hope’s door.

items.title: The VelociPastor 2
items.synEN: The perfect movie DOES exist! Doug and Carol travel to the port city of Milan, where they have to solve a series of murders committed by a masked slasher at an Italian Fertility Festival. And Soviet Spies. INTERPOL’s there, too.

items.title: Khadam
items.synEN: Melor, who is forced to inherit her family's inheritance. As a result, she must race against time to save her daughter from a dark entity that is beginning to take over her life.

items.title: Send Help
items.synIT: Due colleghi un tempo rivali si ritrovano improvvisamente naufraghi su un'isola deserta dopo essere gli unici sopravvissuti a un disastro aereo. Costretti a collaborare per sopravvivere, Linda e Bradley dovranno affrontare vecchi rancori e mettere alla prova la propria forza di volontà per riuscire a salvarsi.
items.synEN: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

items.title: Kombucha
items.synEN: Trapped in a fluorescent-lit cubicle farm, an aspiring musician thinks the free break room kombucha is a perk - until it begins to change him. What starts with suspicious smiles and team-building ends in a bile-drenched metamorphosis.

items.title: The Cure
items.synEN: An adopted 16-year-old with a mysterious illness learns her bio-tech billionaire parents are harvesting her blood for nefarious purposes.

items.title: Dosa: Penebusan atau Pengampunan
items.synEN: Bima and her wife, Ersya, have an accident while they're going out of the town and they are trapped in a mysterious hotel, where they are terrorized and forced to face past sins that cannot be avoided.

items.title: Kijsada Paradise
items.synEN: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

items.title: Vick & Tarstar's Scarecrow Factory
items.synEN: Vick and Tarstar are shooting their latest horror movie trash epic, Scarecrowed, with a cast and crew of punks, drug addicts, fetish models, and dumpster divers. Set back with extra hairy relationship drama, homelessness, lack of funding, and their crew members quitting, Vick and Tarstar just want to tell their story: With the right bucket, you too can buy your own hair cutting scarecrow made by the animatronic Goo Guys at the Scarecrow Factory.

items.title: He Brings the News (Il apporte la nouvelle)
items.synEN: An isolated couple with too much time on their hands develops an unhealthy fascination with their mailman. Violence and absurdity follow as they descend into a world of phantasmagoric delusion.

items.title: Absolution
items.synEN: A minister visits a grieving family in the midst of a missing mother, and finds evil lurking in their home.

items.title: The Prompt
items.synEN: 'The Prompt' takes an everyday tool for some and twists it into a dystopian, inescapable nightmare...

items.title: The Dead Place
items.synEN: Troubled high school senior Isaac [Veliu] is plagued by visions of the dead. This causes friction in his family and makes him an outcast at school. His only friend Katharine [Graves] is obsessed with the paranormal and tries desperately to help him, but a ‘New Kid’ [Thornton] pushes him to give in to the demon trying to burrow its way inside him [Oberst]. As he is consumed by the evil feeding off the dead souls that haunt him, Katharine is the only one that stands between Isaac and his darker impulses. To satisfy the bloodlust of the demon that dwells within him.

items.title: Hallowarrior
items.synEN: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

items.title: What’s Hidden In the Shadows
items.synEN: When a boy gets a phone call at night, he starts to look outside for some answers and a monster captures him.

items.title: The Hallowarrior
items.synEN: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenging the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

items.title: KAGUYA
items.synEN: KAGUYA is a film that shows how society started to act after encounters with Japanese folclore became part of our mundane life.

items.title: Scream 4
items.synIT: Sidney Prescott è l'autrice di un bestseller su come superare i traumi personali e come ultima tappa del tour promozionale del suo libro torna proprio a Woodsboro. Lì riallaccia i contatti con lo sceriffo Dewey e sua moglie Gale, e anche con la giovane cugina Jill e la zia Kate. Ma, con il ritorno di Sidney a casa, tornano anche gli omicidi di Ghostface, che pare prendere di mira il liceo frequentato da Jill.
items.synEN: Fifteen years after the original Woodsboro murders, Sidney Prescott returns home to promote her new book about surviving trauma, only for a new Ghostface killer to emerge, targeting a new group of teens.

items.title: Midsommar - Il villaggio dei dannati
items.synIT: Una coppia giunge in Svezia per far visita a un amico che vive in un villaggio di campagna. L'idea è quella di passare con lui la tradizionale festa di mezza estate che si celebra sul posto. Quella che doveva essere una vacanza paradisiaca si trasformerà presto in una violenta e curiosa competizione per via di un culto pagano.
items.synEN: Several friends travel to Sweden to study as anthropologists a summer festival that is held every ninety years in the remote hometown of one of them. What begins as a dream vacation in a place where the sun never sets, gradually turns into a dark nightmare as the mysterious inhabitants invite them to participate in their disturbing festive activities.

items.title: Hereditary - Le radici del male
items.synIT: Quando l'anziana Ellen muore, i suoi familiari cominciano lentamente a scoprire una serie di segreti oscuri e terrificanti sulla loro famiglia che li obbligherà ad affrontare il tragico destino che sembrano aver ereditato.
items.synEN: Following the death of the Leigh family matriarch, Annie and her children uncover disturbing secrets about their heritage. Their daily lives are not only impacted, but they also become entangled in a chilling fate from which they cannot escape, driving them to the brink of madness.

items.title: If I Cant Have You
items.synEN: McCoy Runquist is violent teenager who just got broken up with by his perfect boyfriend, Carter Smosh. Now he's out to kill!

items.title: Affection
items.synEN: Afflicted by a mysterious condition that resets her memory, Ellie becomes trapped in a cyclical nightmare with a man who claims to be her husband. She soon must uncover the horrifying truth of her existence—before she forgets it all again.

items.title: Ward #7
items.synEN: While on night duty at a psychiatric clinic, student psychotherapist Andriy encounters a patient who knows more about him than he should.

items.title: Pictoman
items.synEN: After a violent car crash, a succsesful musician begins to rethink his life choices and rediscover personal meaning. However, his transformation may not just be exclusively spiritual.

items.title: Bird Flu
items.synEN: An anxiety-ridden man’s decision to take in an injured bird leads to a deep reflection of his traumatic past and an intense physical transformation.

items.title: Never After Dark
items.synEN: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

items.title: Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire
items.synIT: L'epica storia di amore, sangue e pericoli dell'immortalità di Louis de Pointe, raccontata al giornalista Daniel Molloy. Irritato dai limiti della vita da uomo di colore nella New Orleans del 1900, Louis trova impossibile resistere all'offerta del dissoluto Lestat De Lioncourt della fuga definitiva: unirsi a lui come suo compagno vampiro.
items.synEN: Based on Anne Rice's iconic and bestselling novel, Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire follows Louis de Pointe, Lestat de Lioncourt and Claudia's epic story of love, blood and the perils of immortality, as told to the journalist Daniel Molloy. Chafing at the limitations of life as a Black man in New Orleans in the early 1900s, Louis finds it impossible to resist the rakish Lestat de Lioncourt's offer of the ultimate escape: joining him as his vampire companion. But Louis's intoxicating new powers come with a violent price, and the introduction of Lestat's newest fledgling, the child vampire Claudia, soon sets them on a decades-long path of revenge and atonement.

items.title: When You Hear Hoofbeats
items.synEN: When a young woman struggles to have her medical symptoms taken seriously, she starts to believe she’s been possessed by the devil.

items.title: The Strangers: Chapter 3
items.synEN: Tethered by a frightening conclusion, Maya and the Strangers are locked on an unavoidable, unforgiving collision course — a showdown that proves they’re far from strangers now.

items.title: Sleep Call
items.synEN: A lonely young man finds love online when a late-night sleep call with a stranger blossoms into an intimate digital romance.

items.title: En ny dag truer
items.synEN: A misunderstanding occurs that causes Borghild to believe night is day. She begins a new day cycle where she experiences confusion and terror as she is exposed to dark memories from the past.

items.title: Nocturne in White
items.synEN: An office worker drifts through a nameless government building that runs experiments on humans. As repetition begins to distort her reality, she becomes overwhelmed by the guilt and the sneaking suspicion that she may also be a subject of experimentation.

items.title: Breeder
items.synEN: A poodle breeder obsessed with genetic perfection offers an MIT dropout a bizarre proposition — she wants to breed him with her daughter.

items.title: Whispers of Forgotten Videos
items.synEN: this is not my fault. this is not his fault. this is your fault.

items.title: The Lie We Lived In
items.synEN: A contract killer, Seo I Do, arrives at a secluded house to take out his target, Heo Dong Hwa. Before he can finish the job, his boss unexpectedly orders him to stay put and to keep Dong Hwa captive instead. Things get messy fast when a cheerful stranger, Chu Tae Jeong, suddenly shows up. He's an old friend of Dong Hwa and was already promised a week-long stay. Their first meeting crackles with tension, and in the chaos, Tae Jeong mistakes I Do for Dong Hwa's younger brother, who supposedly left for the US years ago. I Do rides that misunderstanding, acting like the brother while quietly plotting to get Tae Jeong out of the way. His plan takes a sharp turn when he discovers Tae Jeong is actually a detective.

items.title: Jurassic Domination
items.synEN: When two military-made, weaponized dinosaurs attack a small mountain town, it's up to the sheriff to figure out a way to stop the creatures before the dinos escape and wreak havoc nationwide.

items.title: Keeper - L'eletta
items.synIT: Liz e Malcolm scappano per un romantico weekend di anniversario in una capanna appartata. Quando Malcolm torna improvvisamente in città, Liz si ritrova isolata e in presenza di un male indicibile che rivela gli orribili segreti della capanna.
items.synEN: Liz and Malcolm escape for a romantic anniversary weekend at a secluded cabin. When Malcolm suddenly returns to the city, Liz finds herself isolated and in the presence of an unspeakable evil that reveals the cabin's horrifying secrets.

items.title: The Convenience Store
items.synEN: Yukino, a part-time worker at a convenience store, and the strange experience she has when she encounters a mysterious customer in the middle of the night.

items.title: Bite The Bullet
items.synEN: A woman swept up in a passionate new romance discovers her boyfriend is the charismatic leader of a secretive cult—only to be abducted by his devoted followers and forced into a harrowing moral dilemma where her survival depends on betraying everything she believes.

items.title: The Box
items.synEN: A father and son’s hiking trip turns sinister when they come across a strange box.

items.title: Chum
items.synEN: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.synIT: Una coppia di avvocati felicemente sposata viene travolta da un uragano quando un famigerato assassino esce di prigione e riemerge dal loro passato.
items.synEN: A storm is coming for happily married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden when Max Cady, the notorious killer they are responsible for putting behind bars, is let out of prison - and he wants vengeance.

items.title: The Gift
items.synEN: After eight long years of grief, Monica - in an act of vengeance - captures the man responsible for her pain and suffering, but they both soon discover that the truth is far more complex and sickening.

items.title: Magenta House
items.synEN: Many would tell you that Magenta House is the pinnacle of progression: wonder drug medications, humane living conditions and frequent, compassionate therapy sessions... but something darker exists beneath the surface. When five patients escape from the experimental health facility, all will take wildly different approaches to their brief reintroduction to society. But one thing is for certain - The cats out the bag now, and nothing will ever be the same...

items.title: Turncoat
items.synEN: A psychotic mastermind holds a group of interconnected strangers captive in a manipulative game with deadly consequences. Young and old, sinners and saints — everyone's guilty of something, but no one wants to pay the price.

items.title: Scary Movie
items.synIT: Ventisei anni dopo essere sfuggiti a un killer mascherato fin troppo familiare, i Core Four tornano nel mirino dell’assassino — e nessun franchise horror è al sicuro.
items.synEN: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

items.title: Slanted
items.synEN: An insecure Chinese-American teenager undergoes experimental surgery to appear white, hoping to secure the prom queen title and peer acceptance.

items.title: Mapas
items.synEN: Julia and Sérgio set out in search of Rebeca, a missing cycling activist, moving through Brasília, a city marked by silence and unresolved histories. Their investigation leads them to forgotten tragedies, where ruins, memories, and unsettling presences begin to intertwine. Blurring the line between the real and the fantastic, Mapas unfolds as a journey through ghosts of the past that continue to echo in the present.

items.title: Prank Night
items.synEN: A young woman seeks revenge on the group of thugs that attacked her family.

items.title: Labirinto dos Garotos Perdidos
items.synEN: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

items.title: The Witness
items.synEN: The Witness follows the experiences of Alex and André Hanscombe as they deal with the devastating impact of a brutal act of violence. When Rachel Nickell was murdered on Wimbledon Common in 1992, André became a single parent overnight. Putting his own grief to one side, he made his son Alex – the only eyewitness to the attack – the centre of his world. Navigating the unscrupulous media furore and the urgency of an increasingly desperate police investigation, his sole concern became the welfare of his traumatised son. This is the story of how a father and son moved through the aftermath of unimaginable tragedy, from darkness into light.

items.title: Saint Clare
items.synIT: In una piccola città, una donna sola è perseguitata da voci che la spingono ad assassinare persone malintenzionate e a farla franca, finché il suo ultimo omicidio non la risucchia in una tana di coniglio piena di corruzione, traffico di esseri umani e visioni dall'aldilà.
items.synEN: In a small town a solitary woman is haunted by voices that lead her to assassinate ill intended people and get away with it, until her last kill sucks her down a rabbit hole riddled with corruption, trafficking and visions from the beyond.

items.title: The Yeti
items.synEN: When an oil tycoon and a famous adventurer vanish into the harsh winter of remote northern Alaska, a hand-picked rescue team endeavors to bring them home. What they don’t know is that they are trespassing on The Yeti’s territory, and the elements are the least of their worries.

items.title: Go Fish 2
items.synEN: Years after a game that was never meant to end, the cards are dealt once more.  What begins as a casual night of UNO among strangers is quietly interrupted by a man who has seen the game before… and survived it. As familiar patterns begin to resurface, the players find themselves slipping into roles that aren’t theirs—voices, memories, and unfinished conflicts bleeding through each turn.  Possession becomes participation. Guilt becomes gameplay.  And the past refuses to stay buried.  As the lines between player and pawn blur, one truth emerges:  Some games don’t end.  They wait.

items.title: Kucing Hitam
items.synEN: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.

items.title: Recluse
items.synEN: Joan is a solitary audio engineer who returns to her family’s decaying country estate after receiving a call from her ailing father, an acclaimed but reclusive artist rumored to have dabbled in the occult. Unearthing a malevolent secret decades in the making, Joan must determine whether the horrors she faces are the product of her father’s misdeeds or her own troubled mind.

items.title: Turn It Up!
items.synEN: An indie rock band struggling to make its mark finds a possible meal ticket in an infectious new guitar riff. Unfortunately, it’s also a cursed melody that just so happens to open a portal to another, much scarier dimension.

items.title: Monster Pabrik Rambut
items.synEN: Two sisters deal with the sudden death of their mother at a wig factory. One believes it was suicide while the other is certain it was a result of possession and takes a job at the factory to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, their brother - born with an eerie gift to regenerate his own body - catches the attention of a ghostly figure roaming the factory, searching for a vessel to inhabit.

items.title: Pinocchio Unstrung
items.synEN: We follow James as his grandfather, Geppetto, introduces him to a seemingly magical doll to become best friends. However, unaware of Pinocchio's naïve nature, as James introduces him to the world it results in the doll going on a crusade to eliminate all things “bad.”

items.title: Saccharine
items.synEN: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

items.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
items.platform: Édition Limitée SteelBook® Blu-ray 4K Ultra HD
items.synIT: Dopo un incidente d’auto, una giovane donna si risveglia apparentemente intrappolata. Teme, infatti, di essere stata rapita dal suo soccorritore che afferma di averla salvata da un attacco chimico che ha reso il mondo esterno inabitabile. Incerta su cosa credere, la ragazza decide di fuggire dal rifugio, qualunque siano i pericoli che l’attendono nel mondo esterno.
items.synEN: After a catastrophic car crash, a young woman wakes up in a survivalist's underground bunker, where he claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack that has left the outside world uninhabitable.

items.title: Calling You
items.synEN: After a middle-aged father falls mysteriously into a coma that transports him to an idealised version of his past, his daughter must do all things necessary to rescue him from an eternal trap.

items.title: The Remedy
items.synEN: A troubled young man is the caregiver for both his terminally-ill mother and his mentally-ill sister. When he makes a desperate attempt to save his mom, he unleashes a supernatural entity that feeds on human flesh.

items.title: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition
items.synEN: In this special edition series of The Proof Is Out There, journalist Tony Harris explores some of the most astonishing phenomena ever captured on camera. From UFOs and cryptids to eerie encounters and unexplained forces, Tony and a team of experts analyze the evidence and deliver their verdict.

items.title: Bodies in the Water
items.synEN: When a missing high school student is found shackled in chains off the shore of Cape May, investigators are baffled by what kind of monster could commit such a heinous murder. Their investigation leads them to uncover jealous boyfriends and turmoil within the victim's foster family that sends shockwaves throughout the tightknit community.

items.title: Hacked: A Double Entendre of Rage Fueled Karma
items.synEN: Based on true events: The Rumble family’s dream of buying their first home turns into a nightmare when Florida’s most elusive hacker, known only as The Chameleon, steals their life savings. But this hacker messed with the wrong family. The banking system failed them. The police won’t help. Furious and desperate, they plot a revenge-fueled takedown of the hacker, determined to make him pay for every life he’s destroyed. What started as a financial tragedy soon spirals into a fast-paced, darkly comedic adventure to reclaim their money—and their dignity. Revenge has never been this fun!

items.title: Obsession
items.synIT: Dopo aver spezzato il misterioso bastoncino del desiderio per conquistare il cuore della ragazza che ama un romantico senza speranza ottiene esattamente ciò che ha chiesto ma presto scopre che alcuni desideri hanno un prezzo sinistro e pericoloso.
items.synEN: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

items.title: Die Nacht der leitenden Reichen
items.synEN: The wealthy Fritz Februar abducts homeless people right of the streets. And his newest invention, the Zombeer, will take his hate for homeless people even further. But Wizzy Wendy and Beatrix Fulci are ready to fight the threat by any means necessary.

items.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
items.synEN: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer takes back the narrative of their lives by sharing disturbing yet empowering accounts of how they escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

items.title: Crawl - Intrappolati
items.synIT: La storia di una giovane donna che si ritrova intrappolata nella sua abitazione, mentre all'esterno impazza un uragano di categoria 5. La ragazza non solo dovrà tentare di salvare suo padre, ma anche fare i conti con il livello dell'acqua che cresce sempre più all'interno della casa, attirando gli alligatori della zona.
items.synEN: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

items.title: Młynki
items.synEN: A mysterious forest somewhere in the Łódź region has for generations inspired fear and curiosity among the inhabitants of nearby villages. They recount the stories they told or heard about ghosts and phenomena that defy rational explanation.

items.title: It Was Just an Accident
items.synEN: Three teenagers accidentally kill someone in their luxury car, then discuss what to do with the body.

items.title: My Willow
items.synEN: A father and daughter that enjoy spending the night in creepy places get more than what they wanted.

items.title: Lethally Blonde
items.synEN: Lethally Blonde offers insight into tragic stories ripped straight from the headlines, exposing the dark side of people pursuing beauty and fame.

items.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders
items.synIT: Il lato oscuro della fama online, dove i sogni diventano incubi.
items.synEN: Social Media Influencers seem to have it all — money, celebrity, power. But in these shocking true crime stories, there is a horrifying dark side to the fame, which reveals how these online dreams can quickly become blood-soaked nightmares.

items.title: Tiger's Rampage
items.synEN: A bachelorette party in the woods becomes a fight for survival when a Bengal tiger escapes the zoo during a storm. Trapped without phone service or escape routes, the women must outwit the predator stalking their cabin.

items.title: Somnophiliac
items.synEN: intrusive conversations about the "social" animal - inspired by Madvin Mexis' graphic novel "I did not write this"

items.title: Chakravaat
items.synEN: Trapped in an endless time loop, a desperate human races against the clock to escape a relentless cycle of terror. With every reset, shadowy figures emerge from the darkness—silent, unstoppable, and closing in for the kill. As reality frays at the edges, he must unravel the mystery of the loop before the shadows claim him forever. A gripping, atmospheric horror short that blends suspense, mystery, and unrelenting dread.

items.title: Dead Roommate
items.synEN: Struggling with anxiety and loneliness, college freshman Victor forms an unexpected bond with his new roommate Abbey, who died in the dorm decades earlier. Together, they discover friendship, courage, and the comforting sense of belonging.
